Own the full sales cycle: from prospecting and lead generation to closing contracts and driving account expansion.
Build and manage executive-level (C-level) relationships to become a trusted advisor.
Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve and exceed sales quotas.
Act as a product expert on Tencent Cloud's digital native offerings, crafting solution-based proposals.
Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Legal, and Finance to deliver value and close complex deals.

Who We Look For
Qualifications & Requirements
Experience: 10+ years of B2B sales experience in technology/cloud/digital sectors, with a proven track record of selling complex solutions to C-level executives.
Skills: A true "hunter" with outstanding ability to close. Exceptional in consultative selling, negotiation, and executive communication.
Mindset: Highly motivated, goal-oriented self-starter with strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Plus: Curiosity and experience in AI; background in E-commerce.
Languages: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in a major European language (e.g., Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese) and/or Mandarin Chinese is a significant plus.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is

CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. Tencent Cloud is seeking an IDC Procurement & Commercial Manager to support infrastructure expansion and carrier partnership development across Europe. This role focuses on sourcing and managing IDC resources within European markets, establishing strong commercial relationships with regional telecom operators, and optimizing network interconnection to enhance service quality for end users. 5. Provide insights into European carrier ecosystems, regulatory environments, and interconnection strategies to support regional infrastructure planning

4. Proven commercial negotiation capability with experience managing cross-border carrier or infrastructure partnerships across multiple European markets
5. Excellent working-level proficiency in both English and Chinese Mandarin, written and spoken, to manage internal and external communications and documentation

While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is looking for a results-oriented and commercially astute Senior Strategic Sales Executive to drive cloud adoption across the broader internet sector, including fast-growing digital-native businesses, platforms, and cross-border internet enterprises. This role is ideal for someone who understands the fast-evolving dynamics of internet clients and can connect Tencent Cloud’s infrastructure, security, and platform solutions to their technical and commercial needs. You will play a key role in expanding our presence across regional markets by managing complex deal cycles, engaging senior stakeholders, and shaping scalable growth strategies.
Responsibilities
Acquire and grow strategic internet accounts across social, gaming, e-commerce, media, and other digital-native verticals.
Build trusted relationships with C-level decision-makers, product owners, and engineering leaders to position Tencent Cloud as a long-term strategic partner.
Understand the unique infrastructure, compliance, and performance demands of internet workloads; match those needs with Tencent Cloud’s IaaS, PaaS, and security product offerings.
Work closely with internal cross-functional teams including pre-sales, product, engineering, and legal to shape solution proposals and close complex deals.
Develop region-specific go-to-market strategies informed by market intelligence, industry trends, and platform-specific requirements.
Represent Tencent Cloud at industry forums and client workshops to elevate product visibility and deepen client engagement.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of cloud solution sales experience, preferably with internet clients or digital-native enterprises.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, content delivery, security architecture, and scaling considerations typical in internet-facing applications.
Demonstrated success in engaging and influencing both technical (e.g., CTOs, engineers) and business (e.g., product leads, GMs) stakeholders.
Fluency in English and Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with regional teams and clients.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership, adaptability, and collaborative spirit in a high-growth, cross-cultural setting.

1.负责游戏美术 Pipeline 相关工具、流程系统及配套服务的设计、开发和维护，覆盖资产生产、流转、校验、发布等核心环节，通过工具和流程优化提升项目美术生产效率与品质；
2.对接项目需求，结合项目管理、程序、美术、TA 等团队协同推进问题解决与方案落地；
3.负责 Pipeline 工具及流程系统的前后端一体化开发，包括工具界面、服务接口、数据流转、权限配置及相关功能迭代；
4.负责技术 Demo、方案文档、培训资料和使用手册的整理与沉淀，推动工具管线在项目中的接入、推广、验收与持续优化；

1.本科及以上学历，3 年及以上游戏行业 TA / TD / Pipeline 相关工作经验，有完整项目落地经验者优先；
2.熟悉游戏美术生产全流程，理解角色、场景、动画、特效等至少一个或多个环节的制作协作方式及核心痛点；
3.具备较强的前后端开发能力，能够独立完成工具界面开发、后台服务开发、数据接口设计及相关系统联调；
4.有美术流程系统开发经验，熟悉资产管理、任务流转、版本管理、质检校验、发布流程等常见 Pipeline 场景；
5.熟练掌握 Python，并至少熟悉一种前端或后端开发技术栈；有 DCC 工具脚本开发、引擎工具开发或流程系统集成经验；
6.具备良好的沟通协调能力和需求拆解能力，能够独立承接项目需求并推动落地；
7.具备快速学习能力、问题分析能力和较强的执行力。

title: 数据中心架构设计及解决方案工程师
description:
1.架构演进：参与负责国内IDC/AIDC 技术路线规划，重点研究高功率密度、风液混部及全液冷架构的标准化落地；
2.方案设计：主导大规模IDC/AIDC基础设施项目的典设方案设计，以及具体项目落地中的深化设计方案评审及优化，确保项目落地过程中的各项技术指标满足业务需求；
3.技术创新：持续推动技术创新及落地，通过冷板/浸没液冷、800V HVDC、分布式储能等新技术新方案，持续提升系统性能、可靠性和成本优化；
4.标准化与产品化：推动基础设施的软硬件标准化，参与协同自研产品的迭代，实现数据中心高性能及快速交付与弹性部署；
5.跨团队协同：联动服务器、网络研发及现场运维管理团队，从全链路视角对数据中心整体进行优化提效。

title: 高性能计算工程师
description:
1.超大规模LLM性能工程： 主导并规划千亿参数级大模型的极致性能优化技术路线。负责 PagedAttention、连续批处理等核心调度策略的深度定制与生产级架构设计，负责 vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 等主流推理框架的内核级优化与落地；
2.低比特与稀疏模型优化： 牵头 INT4/FP8/AWQ 等前沿低比特量化技术的工业级系统化落地，平衡精度与计算效率。并设计面向 MoE 模型的分布式调度、路由、显存管理及跨卡通信的优化方案；
3.统一与多模态架构： 定义并设计一套具备长期扩展性的统一 AI 推理引擎架构，以支撑自回归生成任务，并前瞻性地解决多模态大模型（如视觉-语言模型）的协同推理部署挑战；
4.异构算力与国产化适配： 主导推理引擎在国产AI芯片（如昇腾、海光、天数等）平台上的战略级移植、生态适配与性能优化。对 HCCL/NCCL 等通信原语进行深度优化和定制，实现跨异构架构的算力自主可控；
5.核心算子优化与指令架构创新 (Enhanced Focus):深度介入 GPU/NPU 硬件底层，主导设计和实现LLM特有高性能算子。 重点包括：高性能Attention Kernel、矩阵乘法（GEMM）的深度定制与融合、KV Cache读写优化等关键算子；
6.具备深入理解和利用硬件指令集架构（ISA）和微架构（Microarchitecture）的能力， 通过 CUDA/Triton 或国产芯片底层编程语言，进行SIMD/SIMT指令优化、指令级并行（ILP）及寄存器重用等，将LLM推理性能推向硬件理论极限。
requirement:
1.计算机、人工智能、软件工程等相关专业硕士及以上学历；
2.具备5年以上 AI 系统、高性能计算或底层系统开发经验；
3.具备大规模、生产级大语言模型（LLM）在线推理系统从零到一的架构设计与优化实战经验；
4.精通 C++/Python，具备深厚的系统编程功底，对并行计算、内存管理和性能调优有深入的系统性理解；
5.深入理解 Transformer 架构，具备 vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, LightLLM 等主流推理框架的内核级/源码级深度优化经验；对 KV Cache、低比特量化、连续批处理等核心技术有架构决策能力；
6.具备设计和主导实现高并发、超低延迟分布式服务系统的能力；熟悉 Docker/Kubernetes 等云原生部署运维技术。

团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
策略规划与全周期管理：主导海外东欧区的市场策略与中长期营销规划；基于产品不同生命周期（预约、首发、平稳期），制定整合营销方案，并对最终的用户增长与品牌影响力指标负责。
KOL与内容营销生态建设：构建东欧区网红合作体系，具备撬动头部资源及深度内容定制的能力；把控品牌输出的一致性，指导团队产出具备高传播力的本土化创意内容，通过内容营销驱动用户获取与口碑裂变。
本地市场洞察：拥有深厚的产品理解力及市场发行经验，深度挖掘东欧区玩家画像、审美偏好及社交媒体生态，将市场洞察高效转化为产品增长执行策略。
跨团队协同与赋能：协同发行、运营、及研发等部门，解决项目推进中的关键阻碍，沉淀区域发行方法论。

岗位要求
本科及以上学历，2年及以上游戏发行或互联网整合营销经验，有海外发行案例者优先；
对互联网内容有极高的敏感度，能精准捕捉营销痛点。
具备宏观策略思维，能从复杂的数据中发现问题并快速迭代营销策略，具备较强的逻辑分析能力。
拥有优秀的组织协调能力，能高效推动跨职能、跨时区的项目合作。
具备良好的英语读写能力（能作为工作语言进行商务沟通），有俄语沟通能力者优先。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。
Work Location: China-Shenzhen

title: 企业微信-AI应用后台开发工程师-AI大模型应用（成都/北京）
description:
1.负责企业微信AI应用后台系统的设计、开发与迭代，集成大模型能力，为企业用户提供智能对话、任务自动化等场景服务；
2.构建高可用、低延迟的模型调用与服务调度框架，优化AI请求链路的稳定性与性能；
3.与AI产品、算法团队紧密协作，推动LLM（大语言模型）功能在企微生态中的落地，扩展AI应用能力矩阵；
4.负责分布式后台服务的功能开发、容灾设计与性能调优，保障系统在高并发场景下的可靠性。
requirement:
1.计算机/人工智能相关专业，1年以上工程开发经验；
2.具备良好的编程能力，熟悉C++/Python，有1年以上Linux/Unix后台开发工作经验；
3.了解大模型相关技术原理与基础知识，具备AI系统开发经验者优先；
4.具备良好的问题分析解决能力、责任心强。

title: 大模型训练框架研发工程师-强化学习/精调/蒸馏方向
description:
1.框架开发与优化：负责强化学习、模型精调、知识蒸馏等核心模块的设计与开发，提升框架的训练效率与易用性；
2.分布式训练支持：基于Megatron-LM、DeepSpeed等工具，优化大模型分布式训练策略（数据并行/张量并行/流水并行/专家并行等），解决显存、通信与计算瓶颈；
3.工具链构建：参与开发轻量化训练框架（如LLama-Factory、swift），支持快速模型微调、部署及多硬件平台适配；
4.前沿技术探索：跟踪学术动态（如RLHF、MoE架构、FlashMLA、EPLB、DualPipe等），将最新研究成果转化为框架功能，提升产品竞争力；
5.协作与文档：与产品团队紧密配合，提供框架级解决方案；编写技术文档与案例，赋能公有云客户。
requirement:
1.计算机科学、数学、电子工程等相关专业硕士及以上学历，3年以上深度学习框架或工具链开发经验，精通Python，熟练使用C++；
2.有Megatron-LM、DeepSpeed等开源框架使用或二次开发经验，理解分布式训练、显存优化技术；
3.熟悉 GRPO/PPO 等 RL 算法、veRL/Slime/AReaL等强化学习框架者优先；
4.熟悉CUDA编程、高性能计算优化（如算子融合、通信优化）者优先；
5.熟悉NCCL、MPI等集合通信算法者优先；
6.工程经验上具备大型项目架构设计能力，能独立解决性能调优、多节点调试等复杂问题；
7.综合素养；强烈的技术热情，良好的沟通能力与团队协作精神。

title: Tencent Cloud- Big Data Migration Architect (Indonesia)
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
1. Migration Architecture Design & Hands-on Implementation:
Design architecture migration solutions for public cloud customers. Focus on deep technical implementation for migrating overseas mainstream stacks (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.) to Tencent Cloud WeData + DLC/EMR (storage-compute separation architecture). Deploy migration environments, execute data synchronization, and perform business cutovers on the front line.
2. End-to-End Project Management & Delivery: Take ownership of the overall project schedule, risk control, and technical solution governance. Coordinate internal and external resources to overcome organizational and technical barriers, ensuring the successful final delivery of the migration project.
3. Process Assurance & Technical Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting and resolving complex issues during migration. Ensure a fast and smooth transition to the cloud by managing data consistency, business continuity, and providing comprehensive technical guidance.
4. Deep Technical Optimization: Provide full-stack technical support, including but not limited to SQL syntax automated conversion/rewriting, Spark/Flink operator tuning, and post-migration performance benchmarking. Ensure that business performance on Tencent Cloud meets or exceeds expectations.
5. Product-Research Collaboration & Best Practices: Work closely with Solution Architects (SA) to professionally summarize and feed back real-world customer requirements, pain points, and tool defects. Assist SAs in refining migration roadmaps and co-authoring "Best Practice Manuals" for migrating from overseas cloud platforms to Tencent Cloud.

Who We Look For
1. Hardcore Technical Background: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or related fields; 5+ years of experience in Big Data. Proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, or Python) with strong coding skills and logic conversion capabilities.
2. Overseas Stack Expertise: Familiar with the architecture and use cases of at least one major product: BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake. Understand the differences between these and open-source ecosystems (Spark, Hive); cross-cloud migration experience is a plus.
3. System Analysis & Large-scale Management: Strong capability in system problem analysis and resolving complex architectural issues. Proven experience in cluster performance tuning, troubleshooting, source code optimization, and version upgrades; experience managing large-scale clusters (1000+ nodes) is preferred.
4. Migration Delivery Experience: Extensive experience in Big Data migration implementation and management. Master common migration workflows and methodologies for big data components. Familiar with mainstream vendor platforms and a proven track record of delivering large-scale cloud migration projects (PB-level).
5. Core Component Principles: Deep understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem, with source-code level or deep tuning experience in HDFS, Yarn, Spark, Hive, Flink, Doris, Iceberg/Hudi, etc. Capable of handling underlying compatibility issues in heterogeneous environments.
6. Soft Skills & Professionalism: Excellent customer service awareness, communication, and resource coordination skills. Proactive, self-driven, and highly responsible. Able to thrive under pressure in cross-cloud and overseas migration scenarios.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Indonesia-Jakarta

title: AI Infra强化学习工程师-深圳/北京/上海
description:
1.负责LLM RL、Agentic RL强化学习训练框架的设计、开发与性能优化，支撑大规模 RL 算法（如 PPO、DQN、GRPO等）的高效落地；
2.构建分布式训练体系，优化训推异步、partial rollout、数据并行、模型并行、Replay Buffer分布式存储与调度策略，提升 GPU 利用率与训练吞吐；
3.设计并实现 RL 训练全流程工具链：包括环境封装、数据预处理、模型版本管理、训练日志监控、指标可可视化（TensorBoard/Weights & Biases）等；
4.解决 RL 训练中的工程瓶颈：如样本传输延迟、GPU 显存溢出、训练稳定性（梯度爆炸 / 消失）等问题，提供工程化解决方案；
5.与 RL 算法团队紧密协作，理解算法需求并迭代基础设施，适配多场景的训练需求；
6.跟进强化学习与分布式训练领域的前沿技术（如 VERL、rllm、Agentlightning、Ray、Megatron-LM等），并落地到实际系统中。
requirement:
1.计算机科学、软件工程、人工智能等相关专业，3 年以上工程化开发经验（含 1 年以上 RL 或深度学习基础设施相关经验）；
2.熟练掌握 Python 编程，具备扎实的工程编码能力，熟悉 C/C++ 者优先（底层优化场景）；
3.深入理解深度学习框架（PyTorch），精通分布式训练原理与实践（FSDP/DeepSpeed/Megatron/Ray 等工具使用经验）；
4.具备强化学习基础，理解 RL 训练流程（智能体、环境、奖励机制、经验回放等核心组件），熟悉主流 RL 框架（Ray、VERL、rllm、Agentlightning）者优先；
5.具备复杂系统设计能力，能独立负责基础设施模块的从 0 到 1 搭建；
6.强问题排查能力，能快速定位训练过程中的工程问题（性能、稳定性、资源瓶颈）；
7.良好的跨团队沟通能力，能准确理解算法需求并转化为工程方案；
8.自驱力强，乐于跟进前沿技术，具备快速学习与落地能力。

title: 腾讯云-计算产品架构师
description:

requirement:

3.了解深度学习框架(Pytorch, Tensorflow、DeepSpeed等)，熟悉AI训练和推理场景、常见AI模型；
4.对GPU，分布式计算，RDMA，MPI，GPU Direct 等技术有了解和使用经验优先，有分布式训练、模型训练及推理调优加速相关项目实战经验优先；
5.具备优秀的文档能力，使用文字、图示清楚地表达架构意图，能够熟练编写各类技术文档；
6.具有娴熟的沟通技巧，执行力强，具有优秀的团队合作精神、敬业精神；对互联网与云计算行业有清晰的认知和热情。

title: 高性能计算工程师
description:
1.超大规模LLM性能工程： 主导并规划千亿参数级大模型的极致性能优化技术路线。负责 PagedAttention、连续批处理等核心调度策略的深度定制与生产级架构设计，负责 vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 等主流推理框架的内核级优化与落地；
2.低比特与稀疏模型优化： 牵头 INT4/FP8/AWQ 等前沿低比特量化技术的工业级系统化落地，平衡精度与计算效率。并设计面向 MoE 模型的分布式调度、路由、显存管理及跨卡通信的优化方案；
3.统一与多模态架构： 定义并设计一套具备长期扩展性的统一 AI 推理引擎架构，以支撑自回归生成任务，并前瞻性地解决多模态大模型（如视觉-语言模型）的协同推理部署挑战；
4.异构算力与国产化适配： 主导推理引擎在国产AI芯片（如昇腾、海光、天数等）平台上的战略级移植、生态适配与性能优化。对 HCCL/NCCL 等通信原语进行深度优化和定制，实现跨异构架构的算力自主可控；
5.核心算子优化与指令架构创新 (Enhanced Focus):深度介入 GPU/NPU 硬件底层，主导设计和实现LLM特有高性能算子。 重点包括：高性能Attention Kernel、矩阵乘法（GEMM）的深度定制与融合、KV Cache读写优化等关键算子；
6.具备深入理解和利用硬件指令集架构（ISA）和微架构（Microarchitecture）的能力， 通过 CUDA/Triton 或国产芯片底层编程语言，进行SIMD/SIMT指令优化、指令级并行（ILP）及寄存器重用等，将LLM推理性能推向硬件理论极限。
requirement:
1.计算机、人工智能、软件工程等相关专业硕士及以上学历；
2.具备5年以上 AI 系统、高性能计算或底层系统开发经验；
3.具备大规模、生产级大语言模型（LLM）在线推理系统从零到一的架构设计与优化实战经验；
4.精通 C++/Python，具备深厚的系统编程功底，对并行计算、内存管理和性能调优有深入的系统性理解；
5.深入理解 Transformer 架构，具备 vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, LightLLM 等主流推理框架的内核级/源码级深度优化经验；对 KV Cache、低比特量化、连续批处理等核心技术有架构决策能力；
6.具备设计和主导实现高并发、超低延迟分布式服务系统的能力；熟悉 Docker/Kubernetes 等云原生部署运维技术。

title: AI Infra研发工程师-上海/北京/深圳
description:
1.GPU机型性能评估： 主导不同GPU芯片（含国产芯片及英伟达等国外AI芯片）的性能对比与适配评估，深入理解芯片架构并搭建配套的基准评估工具链；
2.训推框架开发与优化：基于云平台和业界常见训推框架，开发加速方案，满足公有云客户对性能的极致需求；
3.支持主流GPU和异构AI芯片，优化大模型推理性能，打造极致性能成本优势；
4.应用优化：参与重点项目POC和现网问题保障，分析性能瓶颈，快速定位和解决重点问题；
5.前沿技术探索：跟踪学术动态，将最新研究成果转化为框架功能，提升产品竞争力。
requirement:
1.熟悉主流的大模型推理框架及其加速技术，如vLLM、SGlang、TensorRT-LLM等，熟练分析单机及分布式情况下的性能热点和优化手段；
2.熟悉业界主流开源模型结构，例如DeepSeek、Qwen、Wan、Flux等；
3.熟悉主流的训练框架和分布式框架，包括Megatron-LM、DeepSpeed、verL、LLama-factory等，熟悉常见的分布式并行策略，了解显存、通信与计算相关性能瓶颈和优化手段；
4.熟悉自动驾驶相关算法者优先，例如BEVformer、MapTRV2、SparseDrive、FlashOCC、Pointpillars等，熟练分析自驾场景的性能瓶颈和优化方案；
5.熟悉CUDA编程、高性能计算优化（如算子融合、通信优化）者优先；
6.熟悉NCCL、MPI等集合通信算法者优先；
7.工程经验上具备大型项目架构设计能力，能独立解决性能调优、多节点调试等复杂问题；
8.具备良好的沟通能力与团队协作精神，有强烈的技术热情者优先；
9.上述训练、推理至少要求熟悉一个场景；两者都熟悉者优化。

title: 金融科技-大模型应用架构师-支付反洗钱风控方向
description:
1.负责金融风控场景中AI Agent方向的架构升级，提升大模型逻辑推理和任务规划能力，构建具备自主决策、协作与工具调用能力的多智能体系统（Multi-Agent System），推动大模型从“对话式AI”向“任务执行体”演进，解决复杂场景下的自动化问题；
2.深入研究并应用LLM的复杂推理技术（如思维链CoT、思维树ToT），并熟悉应用Prompt Cache，多工具并发调度，上下文隔离，长短期记忆管理，权限与安全收敛等Agent工程化和治理技术，赋予Agent独立探索与解决问题的能力；
3.跟进LLM相关的算法最新技术方向，运用指令微调、强化学习等方法，提升大模型规划、推理与遵循指令的能力，从而提升模型知识边界探索和抗干扰的能力。
requirement:
1.计算机、机器学习等相关专业，硕士及以上学历，具备良好的计算机基础和算法基础；
2.对大模型和Agent有较深入的理解，了解AgentArchitectures/Structures（Multi-Agent、ContextEngineering/Management、ReAct/PlanAct/CodeAct），了解多 Agent 协作相关的交互协议（MCP、A2A、FunctionCall），熟悉常见的LLM实施模式、提示工程、评估框架、代理框架和检索框架等；
3.熟悉模型的Post-training训练技术，能针对特定模型能力问题进行SFT、RL训练优化；
4.有AI应用优秀开源项目贡献者或用AI能力对抗黑灰产经验者优先。

title: 游戏美术 AIGC 项目经理
description:
1.产品规划与路线图管理：负责 AIGC 产品的整体规划、版本迭代计划制定，明确产品目标与里程碑，确保产品按期交付并持续迭代优化；

title: Data Science Intern 107259
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist to help build AI-powered capabilities for our influencer marketing platform. This role focuses on turning data and machine learning into practical product features—from creator discovery and content understanding to campaign optimization and performance prediction.
You will work at the intersection of data science, product, and engineering, helping bring intelligent systems into real world use cases that drive measurable business impact.
1. Applied AI & Model Development
Develop and deploy machine learning / AI models to enhance platform capabilities.
Work on use cases such as: 
Creator segmentation and recommendation.
Creator Content labeling and data analysis.
Campaign performance prediction and optimization. 
Agentic Systems Developing.

2. Problem Framing & Experimentation
Translate business and product problems into data science solutions.
Design experiments to validate hypotheses and measure impact.
Iterate on models based on performance, feedback, and real-world usage.

3. Data Pipeline & Feature Engineering
Work with data engineers to define and build scalable data pipelines.
Clean, process, and structure large datasets (creator data, content metadata, campaign performance).
Design meaningful features that improve model performance.

4. Product Integration
Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to integrate models into the platform.
Ensure models are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.
Contribute to API design, model serving, and inference workflows.

5. Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
Track model performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, business KPIs).
Maintain documentation and ensure reproducibility.

Who We Look For
Core Values
Integrity – You prioritize correctness, transparency, and responsible use of data.
Gamer Native – You understand gaming ecosystems and player/content dynamics.
Pop Culture Fluent – You are familiar with creators, platforms, and digital trends.
Tech-Savvy – You are curious and hands-on with emerging AI technologies.

Technical Skills
Strong foundation in machine learning and statistics.
Proficiency in Python and common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch,scikit-learn).
Experience with data processing (e.g., pandas, SQL).
Familiarity with LLMs, NLP, or recommendation systems is a strong plus.
Understanding of model deployment (APIs, batch/real-time inference) is preferred.

Data & Product Thinking
Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into data science solutions.
Strong analytical thinking and hypothesis-driven approach.
Understanding of how models create value in a product context (not just offline metrics).

Execution & Collaboration
Ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business teams.
Good communication skills—able to explain complex models in simple terms.
Strong ownership and ability to iterate quickly.

Nice to Have
Experience in influencer marketing, advertising, or creator platforms.
Familiarity with social media data (e.g., YouTube, Twitch, TikTok ecosystems).
Experience with embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval systems.
Basic knowledge of data engineering or MLOps workflows.

Example Projects You Might Work On
Build a creator discovery engine using embeddings + similarity search.
Develop a content understanding pipeline (tags, sentiment, brand safety).
Train a campaign ROI prediction model to guide budget allocation. 
Integrate LLMs to improve tool efficiency and automate workflows.

title: 高级海外商务经理 (Senior Overseas BD Manager)
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
中国头部手机厂商（小米、OPPO、vivo、华为、荣耀等）在海外移动游戏发行市场的全生态商务合作，制定并执行针对硬核联盟的年度/季度合作策略。
拓展和维护海外头部广告聚合平台（Applovin、Moloco等），制定并执行休闲游戏合作策略，助力达成业务目标。
根据公司重点区域布局，深入洞察当地游戏生态，挖掘具有高游戏属性的垂直社区、第三方独立商店、拥有高净值玩家的超级APP。
建立完善的渠道数据监控与渠道评估体系，对关键平台和区域有深入、及时的洞察，输出合作策略，提供决策支撑。

岗位要求
本科及以上学历，3年以上游戏行业商务或发行经验，有成功的海外发行项目落地经验；
具备优秀的商业技巧，逻辑能力和语言能力，英语可作为工作语言；
能熟练使用头部的AI工具，提高个人工作效率；

4.对互联网业务高并发、高可用业务架构开发与设计熟悉；
5.对互联网业务设计的微服务、大数据、中间件（ES\MQ）、数据库（Nosql\Mysql）、语音\图像AI处理、音视频技术栈及在互联网业务中的应用场景熟悉；
6.熟悉云计算，熟悉ToB业务流程，有丰富的客户技术咨询经验，有出色的商机洞察能力；
7.积极思考、敢于决断、高效执行、务实坚韧、服务主动；
8.心态开放乐观、善于沟通协作，善于资源整合。

title: AI前线部署工程师FDE
description:
1.深入行业场景，将模糊需求拆解为可执行的技术路线图，主导需求分析、技术选型、架构设计，输出可落地的AI解决方案；
2.主导Agent开发/AI Coding等AI类产品端到端交付；
3.进行Prompt优化、RAG链路调优、模型微调与效果评测，将客户痛点提炼为产品需求，驱动迭代并沉淀场景化最佳实践；
4.开发提效工具和智能体，开展客户与内部技术培训和运营推广，把AI工具嵌入到生产工作流，产生可量化的ROI。
requirement:
1.本科及以上，计算机/AI/数学/物理等工程相关专业，3年以上ToB项目交付/客户支撑经验，2年以上大模型（LLM/Agent）深度应用经验，特别优秀者可放宽年限；
2.独立开发过至少2个完整的AI Agent应用（熟悉ReAct/Plan-and-Execute等Agent架构），独立构建过至少1个生产级RAG知识库系统；
3.精通Python，精通LangChain/LlamaIndex/Dify等主流AI开发框架，熟悉Agent编排和Skills；
4.熟悉大模型API调用、Prompt工程、模型微调、效果评估与选型策略；熟悉Docker/K8s、向量数据库（Milvus/ES等）、公有云平台（腾讯云优先）；
5.深入使用国内外的 AI coding工具，深刻理解架构原理和上下文管理；
6.面对模糊的现实问题能迅速拆解并提炼MVP，具备端到端Own项目结果的主人翁意识，能与非技术高管讨论ROI也能与研发团队深入对齐技术方案；
7.此岗位为腾讯集团旗下子公司编制岗位。

4.具备优秀的跨部门协作与项目统筹能力，执行力和责任心强。

3.具备优秀的故事构建能力，能够独立设计完整任务故事弧线；
4.文本表达能力强，能够根据不同角色与情境写出具有辨识度的对白；
5.对叙事节奏、信息分配与玩家体验有清晰认知，能平衡“讲故事”与“可玩性”；
6.熟悉游戏开发流程，理解叙事与玩法、关卡、系统之间的协作关系；
7.具备较强的审美判断，对演出（镜头、节奏、配音）有基础理解；
8.热爱幻想题材、角色驱动叙事，对“角色与玩家关系建立”有强烈兴趣。

title: 预研动作手游-角色原画主笔

5.跟踪行业前沿美术趋势（重点关注二次元、动漫改编类），积累设计灵感，推动角色原画设计创新，优化创作流程，提升团队整体创作效率和作品品质；

2.项目经验：具备完整原创游戏项目（从立项到上线）角色原画创作经验，能独立负责角色设计全流程，有成熟的个人作品集（需包含完整角色设计案例，含人设、线稿、上色、细节展示）；
3.技能要求：熟练使用Photoshop、SAI等绘画软件，能独立完成线稿、上色、细节刻画；具备良好的设计思维和创意能力，能精准把握不同角色的性格、气质，结合项目设定输出有辨识度的设计；
4.职业素养：责任心强，执行力强，能承受项目压力，按时完成交付任务；具备良好的沟通能力、团队协作能力，能准确理解需求并落地执行；有良好的审美能力，对细节有严格要求，善于接受反馈并快速优化。

2、全球趋势研判： 实时洞察欧美、东南亚等核心市场的休闲素材风向（如真人解说、ASMR、反转剧情、解谜互动等）。前瞻性引入新形式，确保团队在素材表现力上领先竞对。

細かいタスク管理、多文化環境での業務や海外チームとの連携に適応できる方。

高い文書作成能力、コミュニケーション能力、論理思考能力、問題解決能力、積極的な実行力と推進力、高い責任感とチームワーク精神を有すること。

Highly detail-oriented, strong execution skills, clear logic, and strong organizational ability.
Passionate about gaming, with a good understanding of the gaming industry and FPS game ecosystem; familiarity with gaming industry terminology. Experience in game marketing is a plus.
Strong documentation and writing skills, excellent communication and coordination abilities, solid logical thinking, problem-solving skills, proactive execution and initiative, strong sense of responsibility, and team spirit.

title: 腾讯视频-AI Agent工程师-（北京&深圳）
description:
1.负责AI Agent 工作流的设计与研发，落地生图、生视频等业务场景的端到端自动化流程；

requirement:

requirement:

4.技术功底：熟练掌握 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，了解分布式训练、推理优化及多工具协同的工程实现；

6.软技能：自驱力强，学习能力强，沟通协作好，英语阅读能力优秀。

title: Data Science Intern 107361

Who We Look For

• Proficient in Python and SQL.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, execution capabilities, and keen business acumen.
• Passionate about games and the gaming industry.
Other Requirements:
1. Please submit a personal list of gaming experience as part of the application.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

requirement:

5.热爱游戏，对主流竞品的动效专业领域趋势熟悉，具备动效专业深刻竞品分析能力。

title: 天美J1创意中心-资深动画绑定师

2.熟练掌握骨骼搭建、IK/FK切换、柔性骨骼、附属骨骼的设置技巧，擅长权重精细刷取，能精准处理高精度模型、复杂服装（如布料）、道具的绑定难题，确保动作变形自然，无穿模、拉扯问题；

6.必须具备3A游戏项目动画绑定相关工作经验，有完整手游/端游/3A项目上线经验，懂国风/写实/二次元风格绑定者优先，有国外3A游戏、影视级角色绑定经验者优先；

title: 3D动作策略游戏《虚环》-资深3D动效设计师
description:
1.界面动效设计： 负责游戏内所有界面（UI）的进出场动画、转场效果、交互动效以及特殊控件（如弹窗、列表、按钮）的动态表现，提升操作手感的“韧性”与“跟手度”；
2.游戏特效制作： 负责制作局内外的非战斗类特效，包括但不限于：系统提示、获得道具、升级流光、大厅角色展示运镜、Loading界面特效等；
3.资源输出与落地： 熟练使用Unity 3D引擎进行动效资源（粒子系统、Shader、序列帧、Spine动画）的导入、配置与调试，确保效果在手机/PC端的性能达标（Draw Call、Overdraw控制）；
4.设计规范制定： 协同UI设计师制定动效设计语言规范（运动曲线、时长节奏、缓动曲线），确保全游戏动效风格统一且有辨识度；
5.动效叙事： 针对关键剧情节点或系统解锁时刻，设计具有情绪渲染力的动态视觉表现，增强玩家的沉浸感与仪式感；
6.跨部门协作： 与策划、UI设计、程序开发紧密配合，理解功能需求，解决动效在引擎中的实现逻辑问题（如响应时间、层级遮挡、音画同步）。
requirement:
1.软件技能： 精通After Effects（熟练使用Duik、Motion v3等脚本为佳），掌握Adobe Photoshop、Illustrator进行素材拆分与补图；
2.引擎能力： 熟练使用Unity 3D（必须掌握Particle System、动画状态机、Timeline）或Unreal（UE4/UE5）的Sequencer及Niagara/VX Graph；有UGUI/NGUI或UMG使用经验；
3.特效工具： 熟练使用Spine、DragonBones 2D骨骼动画软件，或熟悉Cascade/Niagara粒子编辑器；
4.美术功底： 具备优秀的审美能力，对节奏感、色彩、运动规律（如预备与缓冲、跟随重叠、挤压拉伸）有深刻理解；
5.加分项：“能搭建团队动效制作规范与性能白皮书”、“具备培养新人能力”、“对渲染管线有一定理解”。

title: 腾讯营销-高级数据产品agent算法工程师
description:
1.智能体架构设计与开发：负责核心智能体（Agent）应用的架构设计与开发，利用 LangChain、LangGraph、类 OpenClaw 的技术框架搭建复杂推理链路，实现基于大模型的任务规划、工具调用与状态管理；
2.算法与工程落地：负责 RAG（检索增强生成）、Context Engineering、Function Calling 等技术的深度优化，结合向量数据库、图数据库或 Text2SQL 引擎，提升智能体的知识召回精度和推理成功率；
3.模型调参与评测：跟踪并引入最新 LLM 技术，负责模型的 SFT/RL 微调，搭建完善的 LLM 评测体系，以数据驱动的方式提升模型在具体场景下的表现；
4.系统抽象与能力沉淀：针对多业务接入的需求，抽象并开发配置化、插件化、可观测性等通用能力，确保智能体架构的高可用性、可扩展性及低接入成本；
5.全链路优化：关注 AI 应用的工程化指标（如推理成本、响应延迟、任务成功率），从算法选型、模型量化、Prompt 优化等多维度持续迭代，提升用户体验。
requirement:
1.学历与经验：计算机科学、机器学习、人工智能或相关专业硕士及以上学历（优秀本科酌情考虑），3 年以上后端或算法研发经验；
2.算法基础：在 NLP、多模态、AIGC 或机器学习领域有深入理解和实践经验，熟悉大模型的生成原理与评测方法；
3.工程能力：精通 Python，具备优秀的工程实现能力；熟悉异步编程、分布式系统设计，了解高并发、高可用架构的设计模式；
4.智能体框架：必须具备智能体开发经验，熟练掌握至少一种主流 Agent 架构（如 LangChain/LangGraph/AutoGen/Hermes Agent/NanoBot），并能深入理解其底层原理（如 Agent Executor、Tool Calling、Chain 的设计模式）；
5.检索增强：熟悉 RAG 全链路技术，包括但不限于文档解析、切片策略、Embedding 模型选型、检索重排；熟悉向量数据库（如 Milvus、Faiss、Chroma）或图数据库（如 Neo4j）的应用与优化；
6.调参与优化：对 Prompt Engineering 有深刻理解，精通通过 SFT 或 RL 微调模型提升特定任务能力；有参与 LLM 评测体系建设或基准测试经验者优先；
7.软性素质：具备强烈的问题驱动意识，善于复盘与技术沉淀，乐于分享和团队合作；对 AI 工程化有激情，具备拼搏精神，能在大模型快速迭代的环境中持续学习。

title: Principal Game Designer
description:

Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

3+ years in a creative senior leadership role, such as Lead Designer, Creative Director, Game Director, or equivalent
2+ shipped AAA PC and Console shooter or action games

Deep understanding of multiplayer systems design across PvP, PvE, and co-op

Proven ability to operate at both strategic vision level and hands-on execution level
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across multidisciplinary teams and senior leadership
Ability to give clear creative direction while balancing player experience, production realities, and business goals
Ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback without becoming overly abstract or theoretical
Willingness to travel and collaborate directly with partner studios across Europe

title: 高级广告推荐模型算法工程师
description:
随着广告业务的飞速发展，广告推荐模型正迎来新一轮的范式升级。我们将全面推进 Scaling Up（模型参数量级扩大 + 用户行为序列拉长），以期打破现有模型效果的天花板。
为了承接这一极具挑战的算法演进，我们正在打造新一代广告核心 Infra，全面拥抱原生 PyTorch 生态、全 GPU 训推链路以及基于 UV（User View）的高效样本训练模式等。
加入我们，你将主导这场技术变革，通过极致的算法和工程 Co-Design，大幅提升模型算法迭代效率，最终直接驱动公司营销业务核心 GMV 的增长。

1. 模型 Scaling Up：针对推荐大模型（超大参数量、超长序列特征等），设计并实现序列和非序列特征统一建模新范式。
2. 新一代架构演进：深度参与广告推荐系统核心 AI 基础设施（AI Infra）的设计与研发，推动从传统架构向基于原生 PyTorch 的新一代推荐训练/推理框架平滑升级。
3. 算法与工程 Co-Design：与底层 AI Infra 团队深度协同，深刻理解底层全 GPU 分布式训练（数据并行/模型并行/流水线并行）的特性，通过“算法适配算力”与“算力支撑算法”的双向优化，最大化模型迭代效率。
5. 业务赋能：深入理解广告推荐算法业务线（CTR/CVR预估等），通过底层工程架构和模型算法优化，提升模型实验效率，助力业务指标（收入、GMV等）达成。
requirement:

2. 极佳的 C++ 和 Python 编程能力，具备复杂系统架构设计能力，代码风格良好，追求极致的系统性能。
3. 深入理解 PyTorch/TensorFlow 等主流深度学习框架的底层运行机制（有向无环图优化、内存管理、算子分发等），有定制修改框架底层源码经验者优先。
4. 熟悉 GPU 体系结构，熟练使用 CUDA / C++ 编写高性能算子；熟悉 TensorRT、Triton 等推理加速工具链；具备丰富的性能 Profiling 及瓶颈分析经验。

title: 广告推荐模型Infra算法专家
description:
随着广告业务的飞速发展，广告推荐模型正迎来新一轮的范式升级。我们将全面推进 Scaling Up（模型参数量级扩大 + 用户行为序列拉长），以期打破现有模型效果的天花板。
为了承接这一极具挑战的算法演进，我们正在打造新一代广告核心 Infra，全面拥抱原生 PyTorch 生态、全 GPU 训推链路以及基于 UV（User View）的高效样本训练模式等。
加入我们，你将主导这场技术变革，通过极致的算法和工程 Co-Design，大幅提升模型算法迭代效率，最终直接驱动公司营销业务核心 GMV 的增长。

1. 模型 Scaling Up：针对推荐大模型（超大参数量、超长序列特征等），设计并实现序列和非序列特征统一建模新范式。
2. 新一代架构演进：深度参与广告推荐系统核心 AI 基础设施（AI Infra）的设计与研发，推动从传统架构向基于原生 PyTorch 的新一代推荐训练/推理框架平滑升级。
3. 算法与工程 Co-Design：与底层 AI Infra 团队深度协同，深刻理解底层全 GPU 分布式训练（数据并行/模型并行/流水线并行）的特性，通过“算法适配算力”与“算力支撑算法”的双向优化，最大化模型迭代效率。
4. 业务赋能：深入理解广告推荐算法业务线（CTR/CVR预估等），通过底层工程架构和模型算法优化，提升模型实验效率，助力业务指标（收入、GMV等）达成。
requirement:

2. 极佳的 C++ 和 Python 编程能力，具备复杂系统架构设计能力，代码风格良好，追求极致的系统性能。
3. 深入理解 PyTorch/TensorFlow 等主流深度学习框架的底层运行机制（有向无环图优化、内存管理、算子分发等），有定制修改框架底层源码经验者优先。

What the Role Entails
PUBG MOBILE EEU 团队招募 EECA 电竞经理，支持在 EECA 区域的电竞业务推进。该岗位以项目执行与统筹为核心，需要协调多方资源，确保各类赛事及相关项目高质量、按节奏落地。负责业余赛事（如 PMNC）的日常推进与管理，包括对接办赛方、跟进推广与交付进度、问题反馈及直播验收
协同电竞社媒项目，根据既定策略制定执行计划，协调本地团队与供应商推动内容落地
支持区域性职业赛事（如 PMGO EECA Finals）的执行工作，推进项目方案与资源对接
统筹项目整体进度与沟通，明确时间线与交付物，推动内部团队（如社媒、赛事运营）及外部供应商高效协作并按时交付

Who We Look For
对电竞行业有兴趣，具备基础认知
具备优秀的沟通能力，能够在多团队环境中高效推进工作
具备较强的结构化思维与执行力，做事有条理，能够清晰管理时间线与任务优先级
主动性强，有责任心，能够主动跟进问题并推动解决，而非被动等待指令
抗压能力强，能够适应赛事周期内的高强度工作节奏
英语流利（俄语能力为加分项）

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: China-Shenzhen

title: Supercell游戏《部落冲突》-游戏策划
description:
1.负责游戏前期功能调研及需求确立；
2.负责游戏玩法、游戏系统的设计与策划案输出；
3.负责研发过程中各项工作的决策与跟进，确保功能品质，确保组内沟通顺畅；
4.负责分析、统计数据，根据数据和反馈定制后续优化方案。

1.1-3年的游戏策划经验，有主导过游戏系统或数值中的某一项设计；
2.逻辑能力强，策划方案有较为紧密的逻辑性；

4.有良好的团队合作精神、较强的沟通能力。能主动推进需求进行；
5.热爱游戏，有深度的《部落冲突》游戏经验。

2.具备敏锐的洞察力，能快速捕捉热点，并与《部落冲突》结合形成活跃方案；

4.具备极强的沟通协作能力、责任心与抗压能力，工作严谨细致，能适配项目高压节奏，高效完成全美术板块交付任务；
5.热爱Supercell旗下产品，深度玩家优先。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深关卡策划(玩法设计)
description:
1.负责微恐轻动作合作PVE、PVEVP等玩法关卡的创意设计、原型制作与全流程落地；
2.独立产出关卡玩法方案、机制组合、特殊事件以及基于区域的特殊关卡体验；
3.运用UE蓝图快速搭建玩法原型并敏捷迭代，验证新机制在微恐氛围下的可行性与乐趣点；
4.推进关卡平衡性、战斗节奏、搜集曲线与撤离体验的调优，保证关卡在多人协作下的体验稳定；
5.与主题美术、叙事、战斗、音频等模块紧密配合，强化关卡在微恐轻动作调性下的整体表达。
requirement:
1.资深关卡/玩法策划经验，具备动作/射击/生存恐怖/大世界/搜索撤离等类型关卡设计经历，需提供作品集；
2.能够独立使用UE蓝图搭建关卡原型，有半自动/程序化拼接、随机化资源组合经验者优先；
3.对合作PVE、生存恐怖、Roguelite、规则怪谈等类型有深入理解与成功案例；
4.对民俗、怪谈、都市异境等微恐题材有浓厚兴趣，能够贡献具差异化的玩法创意；
5.具备优秀的审美与跨专业协作能力，有导演、建筑、电影等相关专业背景或爱好者优先。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深关卡策划(PVEVP方向)
description:
1.负责微恐轻动作PVEVP大地图的关卡设计、节奏规划与体验交付；
2.主导地图分区、资源点位、AI压力、出入口动线、撤离点与对抗节奏的整体设计；
3.持续对局内数据、热力图、对抗频率、撤离成功率等数据进行分析并指导迭代；
4.与战斗、AI、系统、美术、音频等模块紧密协作，保证PVEVP关卡的对抗公平性与氛围沉浸感；
5.规划赛季化地图更新节奏，沉淀大地图设计方法论及外包协作标准。
requirement:
1.资深PVEVP/搜索撤离类大地图设计经验，至少主导过一款同类产品大地图从设计到上线的完整流程；
2.具备数据驱动的关卡调优能力，熟悉以热力图、胜率、对抗路径等数据指导设计迭代；
3.熟练使用UE编辑器、蓝图与相关场景工具，有 World Partition / 大世界分区经验者优先；
4.对动作/射击/生存恐怖/搜索撤离产品有深入研究，具备氛围化大地图的设计理念；
5.具备优秀的跨部门沟通推动能力，能够在多模块协同中把控质量与进度。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深任务策划
description:
1.负责主线、支线、赛季主题任务、日常任务体系的整体规划与版本化迭代；
2.结合基地运营玩法，设计自然融入叙事的任务链路与引导体验；
3.统筹任务的触发条件、目标、奖励、引导 UI、表现反馈等各环节文档与落地跟进；
4.与叙事、关卡、系统、UI、数值密切协作，确保任务体验与局内外循环无缝衔接；
5.根据任务相关留存、转化、完成率数据，持续优化新手期/成长期/赛季期玩家体验。
requirement:
1.有资深任务/引导系统策划经验，至少 1 款完整上线产品的任务体系建设经历；
2.熟悉多种任务框架与剧情任务、赛季任务、随机任务等不同形态的设计方法；
3.拥有较好的剧情落地能力，合理把控任务语言与节奏；
4.熟悉新手引导与付费漏斗的数据化设计方法，善于以数据指导迭代；
5.有良好的跨团队沟通能力，能推动多方协作落地高质量任务体验。

5.建立系统策划文档模板、评审流程、风险清单和新人培养机制，提升团队方案质量与协作效率。
requirement:
1.5年以上系统策划经验，有主系统/系统负责人经历，负责过3个以上中大型系统从设计到上线/测试的完整落地；
2.具备在线游戏长线运营、成长/经济/社交/赛季/活动等系统架构经验，理解内容消耗、留存、付费和社交行为的关系；
3.逻辑抽象、文档表达和规则推演能力强，能处理复杂数据结构、系统联动、边界条件和异常流程；
4.熟悉UE或同类引擎项目的研发协作方式，能与程序、交互、运营、数据、美术高效推进系统落地；
5.具备产品判断、数据复盘、优先级取舍和团队辅导能力，能在快速迭代中保持系统一致性和长期扩展空间。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深商业化策划
description:
1.负责游戏商业化系统整体架构设计，包含商城、通行证、礼包、外观体系、付费活动等模块；
2.制定商业化内容的版本规划、上线节奏与投放策略，结合微恐轻动作调性设计差异化商业化玩法；
3.推动商业化系统与局外养成、赛季、社交等模块的联动设计，打造长期可持续的付费体验；
4.基于数据洞察持续优化付费转化漏斗、ARPPU与LTV，平衡付费体验与非付费玩家体验；
5.与美术、UI、运营、市场紧密协作，推动商业化内容从设计到上线的全流程高效落地。

3.对外观向、长线运营向产品的商业化节奏与内容主题策划有深刻理解；
4.对微恐、民俗、怪谈等类型题材的外观与IP商业化敏感，具备一定的内容创意能力；
5.具备优秀的跨部门沟通与项目推进能力，能协调多方资源保障版本交付。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深活动运营
description:
1.负责游戏版本内外活动的整体规划与设计，涵盖节日、赛季、联动、成就等多类型活动；
2.结合微恐轻动作调性与世界观，产出具话题性与沉浸感的活动创意，串联局内体验与局外运营活动；
3.推动活动方案从策划到上线的完整落地，协调研发、设计、商业化、社区等模块的协作；
4.负责活动数据分析与复盘，沉淀活动模板与方法论，持续优化参与度与转化效果；
5.监控玩家反馈与舆情变化，快速响应并调整活动方向。
requirement:
1.资深活动运营经验，至少完整经历过一款中大型上线产品的赛季化或版本化活动规划与执行；
2.具备优秀的创意与落地能力，能够在微恐轻动作调性下设计氛围化、沉浸化的活动；
3.熟悉活动数据指标体系，具备基于数据做活动调优与AB实验设计的能力；
4.熟悉不同平台玩家生态与运营节奏，具备一定的内容创作或内容合作经验者优先；
5.具备较强的抗压与执行能力，能够在多项目并行下稳定交付。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深社区运营
description:

title: 腾讯安全-算法工程师-设备风控方向
description:
1.核心模型研发：负责构建与优化设备标识、设备风险画像、设备环境安全检测等核心模型，应对黑产设备伪装、模拟器、设备农场等安全威胁；
2.前沿技术探索与落地：研究并应用图神经网络、深度学习、大模型等先进算法，从设备行为序列、设备软硬件信息、网络信息等非结构化数据中挖掘风险模式，提升对新型攻击的感知与防御能力；
3.全链路建模：主导从设备数据采集、特征工程、模型训练、评估到在线部署与监控的完整建模流程，确保模型在高并发场景下的稳定与高效；
4.深度分析与迭代：对设备风险案件、模型决策进行深度归因分析，持续追踪黑产技术演进，驱动模型与特征的迭代优化。
requirement:
1.学历背景：数学、计算机科学、信息安全、人工智能等相关专业硕士及以上学历；
2.算法能力：精通机器学习与深度学习算法，熟悉常见大模型的算法结构，并具备在复杂、对抗性场景下的模型构建与调优经验；
3.工程与数据能力：熟练掌握SQL、Python，了解Spark等大数据处理技术，具备一定将复杂模型工程化能力。

title: Game Engineer (Intern) 107485
description:
部署紹介/Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS は、物語性の高いストーリー、没入感のあるゲームプレイ、最先端のテクノロジーを駆使し、ゲーム開発をアートとサイエンスの融合として追求し続けています。世界中のプレイヤー、そしてあらゆるデバイスに次世代のゲームエクスペリエンスを提供することを使命としています。
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
Job Description
- Game Feature Development: Participate in the design, development, and debugging of game client modules, implementing gameplay systems and interaction logic
- Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize client-side performance, addressing issues related to frame rate, memory usage, and loading times
- Game AI: Contribute to the design and implementation of AI behaviors for NPCs, enemies, and bosses, including behavior trees and state machines
- AI Harness Engineering: Build and iterate on the supporting framework for AI agents in games, including prompt design, tool calling, context management, evaluation pipelines, and the integration of LLMs / agents with the game runtime

応募資格/Who We Look For
Requirements
- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, or a related field (Junior year and above for undergraduates / Master's students)
- Proficient in C++
- Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine or Unity
- English: Strong reading and writing skills
- Japanese: JLPT N1 or equivalent proficiency
- Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming
- Genuine passion for game development; an active gamer
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
Nice to Have
- Personal or team-based game development projects (Demos / Game Jams / portfolio works)
- Understanding of network synchronization, physics engines, and related systems
- Experience in AI Harness / Agent framework development (e.g., prompt engineering, tool calling, agent pipeline design, LLM application evaluation)
- Familiarity with reinforcement learning fundamentals (e.g., PPO, DQN, and other common algorithms)
- Familiarity with mainstream LLM APIs or agent development frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen)
- Knowledge of game AI techniques (behavior trees, GOAP, pathfinding algorithms, etc.)
- An active GitHub profile, technical blog, or game portfolio
- Experience with version control tools such as Git or Perforce

title: Agent Evaluation Intern 107491
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are hiring an intern to work on evaluation and reliability infrastructure for a real-world LLM agent system in the UA performance marketing field. The agent performs multi-step reasoning, retrieves context, selects tools, executes actions, handles user confirmations, and interacts with external services.
The goal of this internship is to build transferable expertise in agent evaluation engineering: evaluating tool use, measuring trajectory quality, designing benchmarks, analyzing traces, comparing model and prompt variants, and improving the reliability of agentic AI systems.
This role is ideal for someone interested in future opportunities in LLM agent evaluation, AI safety evaluation, research engineering, LLMOps, or applied AI infrastructure.Research the state-of-the-art agentic workflow evaluation frameworks in the industry and in the research field.
Apply the theory to build automated evaluation pipelines that can run agent scenarios, capture execution artifacts, score results, and detect regressions.
Evaluate tool-use behavior, including whether the agent selects the right tool, passes correct arguments, avoids unnecessary calls, and handles tool errors appropriately.
Analyze agent trajectories using traces, logs, intermediate steps, and final outputs to identify reasoning failures, context misuse, hallucinated assumptions, and brittle workflow patterns.
Design metrics for agent reliability, including success rate, tool-call precision, argument accuracy, recovery rate, retry count, latency, cost, and safety-related failure rates.
Create reusable evaluation datasets from synthetic cases, golden workflows, and real anonymized executions.
Support experiments comparing prompts, model providers, tool descriptions, memory strategies, context construction methods, and execution modes.
Help build human evaluation workflows and rubrics for judging agent correctness, faithfulness, usefulness, and risk awareness.
Work with engineers to translate evaluation findings into better tests, monitoring signals, tool interfaces, prompts, and guardrails.
Potentially compose research papers and publish in scientific conferences.

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing or recent graduates of a Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Strong Python fundamentals and interest in AI systems.
Curious about how LLM agents work, fail, and improve.
Interested in evaluation methodology, not just application building.
Comfortable reading logs, traces, test cases, and structured data.
Detail-oriented and able to define clear, measurable criteria for ambiguous agent behavior.
Prior experience with LLMs, LangChain-like agents, tool calling, pytest, data analysis, or observability tools is helpful but not required.

title: 海外休闲IAP（二合）产品负责人
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1. 产品全局把控： 主导休闲消除类游戏产品的整体方向和愿景，制定清晰的产品路线图和升级战略，确保从0到1的创意落地以及从1到N的持续迭代增长，实现产品代际跃升；
2. 跨部门协同： 密切与用户获取（UA）、市场发行、数据分析和商业化团队合作，根据海外市场的买量策略和增长机制及时调整产品方向；结合市场反馈和数据洞察，制定游戏运营活动、付费策略和功能更新计划，推动产品持续增长与长期留存；
3. 质量与进度负责： 把控游戏开发的关键里程碑和最终质量，对产品的品质、进度和预算负责；及时识别和解决项目风险和瓶颈，确保产品按计划上线并达到预期的用户满意度和商业目标；

岗位要求
1. 行业经验： 8年以上游戏开发从业经验，3年以上制作人/主策/产品负责人角色经验，深耕手机休闲游戏领域；
2. 产品类型成功经历： 拥有二合品类休闲游戏的成功项目经验，曾主导或深度参与过知名相关产品的开发或运营；项目月流水超过500万美金。
3. 发行思维： 深刻理解海外移动游戏市场的用户获取渠道和产品增长机制，熟悉买量投放、市场营销和商业化策略；具备数据驱动的思维方式，善于通过A/B测试和用户数据指导产品迭代，提高关键指标（留存、LTV等）；
4. 跨职能协作： 优秀的沟通协调能力，能够在产品、研发与运营等不同部门之间架起桥梁，并与用户获取、发行、营销、商业化等职能团队紧密协作，确保产品开发与市场策略步调一致；
5. 团队领导力： 出色的领导管理才能和人际沟通技巧，善于发掘和培养人才。曾经成功组建并管理过不少于10人的跨职能游戏开发或运营团队；能够在多元文化环境中工作，激励团队实现高绩效；
加分项：
1. 海外合作经验： 有与国际游戏工作室联合开发项目的经验者优先；了解海外合作方的工作方式，能有效管理时区差异和跨文化沟通；
2. 知名企业背景： 曾在国际或国内一流休闲游戏公司担任核心制作岗位者优先，对精品休闲手游的研发流程和品质要求有一线认知；
3. 全球发行经验： 有面向全球市场发行游戏的经验，熟悉海外各主要地区玩家偏好和市场趋势；曾主导产品获得海外市场成功者尤佳；
4. 激情与创新： 对休闲手游充满热情，关注最新的游戏玩法趋势和创新机制，拥有敏锐的市场洞察力和创造性思维，愿意大胆尝试将产品提升到新的高度。
5. 语言能力： 能够熟练地用英语进行沟通和报告，能够在跨国团队中协同工作，并有效地与海外合作伙伴进行交流更佳。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

As a Strategic BD and Investment Manager, you will: 
Lead frontline engagement with AI/tech or AI+ application companies to identify collaboration opportunities and establish long-term partnerships;
Identify and evaluate high-potential investment opportunities and strategic partnerships at the intersection of Tech/AI and Games/Entertainment.
More importantly, drive development of new opportunities and incubate new businesses Act as the primary external-facing representative to bridge Tencent’s internal teams (studios, tech platform) with external innovators and ecosystem players.
Monitor and analyze emerging technology and AI trends in gaming and entertainment.
Develop and maintain a strategic framework for market analysis and opportunity assessment;
Work directly with senior management across global AI and games markets. Work in a team with high-calibre executives previously from top-tier consultancy firms and investment banks.
You will be responsible for supporting decision-makings for executives and leaders of business groups.
Provide game changing strategy and inspire out-of-the-box thinking to senior leader. Plan and manage business incubation, drive product innovation and new partnerships, develop and execute go-to-market plan.

岗位要求
Have more than 3 years of work experience in tech investment or strategy consulting, preferably with a focus on gaming/entertainment or TMT industries.
An advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a similar field is a strong plus.
Demonstrate strategic vision, business insights and in-depth knowledge of emerging technologies and market trends (particularly AI applications in gaming). Proficiency in analyzing market data, financial metrics, and technology trends to identify promising opportunities in game tech/AI.
Must be a self-starter, capable of navigating ambiguity and driving investment strategies from ideation to execution, while collaborating with cross-functional teams.
Effective team players with excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Exceptional proficiency with MS Excel & PowerPoint; working knowledge of statistics and analysis packages.
Fluent in English and Mandarin.
Have an entrepreneurial spirit.

title: Tencent Cloud - Senior Channel Sales Executive (Singapore)
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is seeking an accomplished Senior Channel Sales Executive to drive partner ecosystem growth and revenue expansion, based in Singapore. This role is ideal for a seasoned channel professional with a proven track record in cloud indirect sales and a deep understanding of building scalable partner-led motions. You will work closely with Partner Operations, Solutions Engineering, Business Contracts, and cross-functional leadership to recruit and enable high-value partners, execute joint go-to-market strategies, and manage strategic account relationships from onboarding through renewal. This position offers significant ownership over the partner portfolio and a clear pathway to shape Tencent Cloud's channel presence.
Responsibilities 
Drive channel partner revenue by promoting cooperative selling strategies, achieve/exceed sales goals and quotas, sustain revenue growth, and provide recommendations to enhance account expansion.
Build deep understanding of customers' businesses and partners' strategies/needs/profitability drivers; develop C-level relationships with key decision-makers across the partner ecosystem.
Improve partner performance through best practices, training, and support; manage the complete Partner sales lifecycle -- recruitment, onboarding, co-selling, renewal, and upsell for all assigned accounts.
Prepare and execute strategic account plans based on industry trends (FSI / Pan-Internet / ISV) and customer analysis; own pipeline reporting, revenue forecasting, and quota attainment.
Work closely with Solutions Engineering teams to ensure Partners gain high value from their investments; become proficient in Tencent Cloud's offerings (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, CDN, AI/ML) to deliver compelling service solutions.
Partner with Business Contracts Manager on contract negotiations; develop and manage high-value relationships with key stakeholders across internal and external parties.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent; cloud certifications a plus.
5+ years' experience selling cloud services through partners and working with large, high-profile accounts; strong knowledge of public cloud, CDN, SaaS industries; experience with hyperscaler partner programs (AWS APN, Microsoft CPP, etc.) preferred.
Excellent communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese to manage internal and external stakeholders.
"Hunter" mentality with outstanding ability to close sales; proven record of generating leads, pursuing opportunities, and articulating complex solutions to decision-makers and executives.
Existing network of MSP / SI / ISV partners in Singapore / SEA is advantageous; background in FSI, Manufacturing & Energy, or Pan-Internet verticals a plus.
Experience working closely with cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering and Business Contracts to drive end-to-end partner success.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

About Tencent
Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen, China, our guiding principle is to use technology for good.
We are not only a major video game publisher in the world, we also produce other high-quality digital content, enriching interactive entertainment experiences for people around the globe. We offer a range of services such as cloud computing, advertising, FinTech, and other enterprise services to support our clients' digital transformation and business growth.
We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward.

Job Overview
Tencent is seeking a seasoned communications specialist to drive the global communications strategy primarily for Tencent Games and game titles in Northeast Asia market, and secondarily support Tencent's corporate communications across Northeast Asiaa market.

This is a strategic, high-impact role for a communications professional who can blend cultural fluency, strategic rigor, and creative instinct to shape how Tencent Games in global market. You will be the in-market communications partner for our portfolio of world-class studios and titles, the steward of regional media relationships, and a key advisor to global and regional leadership on reputation, narrative, and market dynamics.

The role is based in Tokyo or Seoul. You will report on a solid line to the Head of Tencent Games Global Communications, and on a dotted line to the Head of Tencent APAC Corporate Communications, working at the intersection of Tencent Games' global
comms function and Tencent's broader corporate reputation agenda in the region.● Define and own the communications strategy for Tencent Games and game titles in Northeast Asia market, translating global priorities into locally resonant strategy and narratives that build relevance, trust, and player affinity.
● Drive communications for Tencent Games' portfolio — including published titles and partner studios — across the full product lifecycle in in Northeast Asia market.
● Partner across studios, publishing, marketing, legal, compliance, public affairs, and global comms peers to deliver integrated, well-aligned communications strategy.
● Manage PR agency partners and coordinate with internal stakeholders to drive quality execution, effective resource allocation and measurable communications outcomes.
● With a primary focus on coordinating and executing media communications plans for Tencent's game business in Japan and Korea, including the planning and execution of media events such as press briefings, exhibitions, open days, media tours and executive engagements.
● Support communications needs across Tencent's business groups, namely social communications, digital content, payment, enterprise solutions, in Northeast Asia.
● Build and maintain relationships with the media and relevant external partners to support Tencent's game business and and other business groups, corporate reputation effort in Japan and Korea.
● Lead local content planning and contribution for Tencent's owned channels in Japan and Korea, including social media platforms, websites, newsletters and other corporate communications materials, as well as gather and localize content from internal teams to ensure locally relevant messaging across channels.
● Monitor local media landscape, industry trends and public sentiment, and support issues management and crisis communications in Japan and Korea, working closely with Game Global Comms team/APAC Corporate Communications, business teams, legal and policy teams where needed.

Who We Look For
● 5+ years of experience in PR, corporate communications, or media relations, ideally with meaningful experience at a global company or top-tier international communications agency.
● Solid, hands-on craft across the core PR disciplines — strategy and messaging development, executive and editorial writing, media pitching and event execution, issues and crisis management, spokesperson preparation, and reputation management.
● Demonstrated track record of leading in-market communications and media relations in Japan, with strong existing relationships in the Japanese media landscape.
● Native or near-native Japanese or Korean, written and verbal.
● Fluent Chinese (Mandarin) and/or English — at least one is required at a working professional level.
● Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, cross-time-zone organization.
● Bachelor's degree or higher in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
Preferred
● a video gamer.
● Prior PR / communications experience in the video games or technology industry.

title: OG项目组-3D 场景设计师（自然生态向）
description:
1.负责写实风格开放世界项目中自然生态类场景内容的制作与落地，包括但不限于：地形、山体、岩石、植被、树木、灌木、草地、水体、地表材质、生态装饰物等；
2.根据项目美术风格及世界观设定，完成不同生态群系/地貌环境的视觉设计与场景搭建，如森林、山地、湿地、荒野、河谷等；
3.使用 UE5 完成场景资源整合、植被铺设、地表混合、氛围塑造及效果验证，确保美术表现达到项目品质要求；
4.与关卡、美术、TA、技术、策划紧密协作，参与开放世界生态区域的内容规划与制作流程优化；
5.负责生态类资产的规范制定与品质把控，包括模块化思路、材质统一性、生态层次、真实感与可玩性平衡；
6.关注项目在不同平台上的表现，配合完成性能优化，包括但不限于 LOD、HLOD、植被密度、材质复杂度、资源预算控制等；
7.参与外包资源审核、反馈与整合，保障生态向资产和场景结果符合项目标准；
8.持续关注行业前沿生态制作技术与工具，将AI等新技术融入项目生产提升效率。
requirement:
1.美术相关专业优先，3-5年以上游戏3D场景美术经验，有写实开放世界项目经验者优先；
2.扎实的美术基础，具备良好的造型、结构、材质、色彩、空间、光影理解能力，对自然生态环境有较强观察力和还原能力；
3.熟悉写实风格场景制作流程，能够独立完成生态向场景资产制作与整体搭建；
4.熟练使用以下至少多项工具：Maya / 3ds Max / Blender、ZBrush、Substance 3D Painter/Designer、Photoshop、SpeedTree、UE5；
5.熟悉 UE5 生态场景相关功能与工作流，包括但不限于：Landscape、Foliage、Material、Nanite、Lumen、World Partition、PCG 等；
6.具备开放世界项目相关经验，理解大地图场景生产方式、生态分布逻辑及玩家视线引导；
7.有良好的沟通与协作能力，能与上下游岗位高效配合，推动场景品质落地；
8.熟练运用AI工具辅助写实场景参考、细节优化、质感提升，具备高效制作工作流。

title: 研发项目经理-大模型训练infra团队（北京/深圳）

2.搭建并落地项目质量监控体系，全程把控项目进度、交付质量与风险，保障项目按时、高质量交付；

3.具备前瞻性思维与风险预判能力，能够从基础设施视角审视项目，提前识别流程、协作、技术侧潜在风险并落地管控；
4.精通研发项目全流程管理，擅长进度把控、质量管控、资源协调，有过多模态、系统稳定性类项目管理经验者优先；
5.优秀的沟通表达、逻辑分析与问题解决能力，耐心细致，抗压性强，善于梳理协作问题并输出优化方案；
6.具备流程优化意识，能够结合团队现状制定适配的协作规则，持续提升团队整体研发效率。

5.熟悉UE4，熟悉UI开发流程；
6.对于PC及Console游戏有一定的体验积累。

1.核心系统开发： 深度参与输入法核心业务逻辑的设计与研发，攻坚后台基础架构、模型推理、高性能检索、多模态数据处理等技术难点；

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Business Unit

What the Role Entails
About Tencent Cloud
Tencent Cloud solutions, originating from our deep expertise in gaming, social, and media services, have taken on a new mandate: serving industries across the board with end-to-end, AI-native cloud capabilities. Our AI portfolio spans MaaS (Model-as-a-Service), Agent frameworks, Machine Learning, and AI Infrastructure — alongside IaaS, Big Data, EdgeOne, MPaaS, CPaaS, and Private Cloud. We bring this platform to enterprises of all sizes, meeting them where they are with a secure, easy-to-use, and cost-effective suite of cloud services. Today, Tencent Cloud has successfully extended its footprint to 21 markets worldwide.Responsibilities
Act as Human Resources Business Partner to the Tencent Cloud business lines across Americas, including United States and Brazil, providing localized support and ensuring alignment with global and regional HR strategies.
Being a trusted advisor to provide insights on business decisions from a human capital perspective which includes but not limited to talent management , performance m anagement, workforce strategy, employee engagement & retention. 
Collaborate closely with the business leaders on people matters which may have short-, medium- or long-term effects on the business.
Identify opportunities for resource sharing and ensuring compliance in workforce decisions
Driving and helping to connect the dots between regional/local decisions in contrast with HQ decisions, to mediate and align expectations across all parties
Lead and manage cross-functional HR projects and collaborate with other BPs to promote strategic alignment and project execution.
Challenges
Ability to operate in ambiguous and grey-zone scopes — defining and creating value where frameworks don’t yet exist.
Requires self-direction and initiative to build new relationships, identify gaps, and drive change.
Must be comfortable navigating cross-cultural stakeholder management and regional diversity.

Who We Look For
Qualifications
3-5 years of HR experience, either as consultant, Human Resources Business Partner, HR function specialist, or recruitment is welcome. 
Strong regional exposure across Americas, demonstrating strong stakeholder management skills and business acumen
Someone who is positive, possess a can-do attitude and can navigate in highly matrixed and ambiguous environments
Strong people skillsets and able to build relationships across all levels of staff, be culturally sensitive and adaptable to different people styles 
Strong learning agility, with good ability to bounce back and quickly learn from past experiences, improve, and adapt
Multi-lingual abilities (English/Chinese/Português) will be considered a competitive edge as it will be required to deal with employees locally
Be willing to be based in Shenzhen for the first 3-6 months of employment to get on board and integrate into the team.
Location State(s)
US-California-Palo Alto
The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $82,700.00 to $155,800.00 per year. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Employees hired for this position may be eligible for a sign on payment, relocation package, and restricted stock units, which will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Subject to the terms and conditions of the plans in effect, hired applicants are also eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits, and participation in the Company’s 401(k) plan. The Employee is also eligible for up to 15 to 25 days of vacation per year (depending on the employee’s tenure), up to 13 days of holidays throughout the calendar year, and up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
Your benefits may be adjusted to reflect your location, employment status, duration of employment with the company, and position level. Benefits may also be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year.

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to change and manage competing priorities
Strong technical project leadership and stakeholder management skills

title: Game Community Intern 107657
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a passionate and highly community-driven Community Intern to support our PC and Console game publishing efforts in London.
This role is ideal for someone who is deeply familiar with gaming communities, internet culture and player conversations. You will help create engaging community content, identify viral opportunities, support communication with players, and work closely with internal teams to translate gameplay updates into player-friendly messaging.
The ideal candidate is both a hardcore gamer and a creative community native - someone who understands what players care about, speaks their language, and knows how to make content feel authentic, timely, and shareable.
Responsibilities1. Support day-to-day community operations for PC and Console game titles across key social and community platforms. 
2. Create and contribute ideas for engaging, and player-relevant community content, including memes, short videos, social posts, and trend-led content. 
3. Monitor player discussions, community sentiment, gameplay feedback, and emerging trends across platforms such as Discord, Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, X, Twitch, and other relevant channels. 
4. Help identify high-potential community creators, KOLs, streamers, and gaming influencers.
5. Translate gameplay updates, feature changes, events, and patch notes into community-friendly language that resonates with players. 
6. Work closely with publishing, marketing and development teams to ensure player-facing messaging is accurate, engaging, and authentic. 
7. Help collect, organize, and summarize community feedback for internal teams. 
8. Stay up to date with PC/Console gaming trends, player culture, memes, creator content, and competitor community activities. 

Who We Look For
1. A hardcore PC and/or Console gamer with strong knowledge of gaming culture, player communities, and online gaming conversations. Previous game operations/community experience is preferred.
2. Strong understanding of internet culture, memes and youth-oriented social media trends. 
3. Good sense of what makes content engaging, authentic, and shareable within gaming communities. 
4. Strong written English communication skills, with the ability to write in a natural, player-friendly, and community-native tone. 
5. Comfortable communicating with both players and internal teams, including developers and publishing stakeholders. 
6. Passion for PC/Console games, especially multiplayer, shooter, action, RPG, live-service, or community-driven titles.

title: Senior Game Engine Programmer
description:
Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a Senior Game Engine Programmer to join our engine team and contribute to the development and optimisation of cutting-edge game engine technologies. In this role, you will work on core engine systems across areas such as engine architecture, rendering, animation, physics, performance optimisation and cross-platform development.
You will collaborate closely with gameplay, tools, art and production teams to build scalable and high-performance engine solutions for multiple platforms, including mobile, PC and console. You will also help solve complex engine challenges, and mentor other engineers within the team.1. 4. Analyse and resolve complex performance, stability and scalability issues across different platforms.
5. Follow and apply the latest technical developments from industry conferences and research papers, such as SIGGRAPH and GDC.
6. Provide technical guidance, code reviews and mentorship to other engineers on the team.

Who We Look For

6. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in complex technical areas.
7. Good communication skills and experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
8. Self-driven, detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality technical work.
Preferred Qualifications
1. Experience with commercial engines such as Unreal Engine.
2. Deep expertise in rendering, animation systems, physics simulation or engine performance optimisation.
3. Experience with profiling, debugging and optimisation across multiple platforms.
4. Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical initiatives.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Associate, Global AI Policy
description:
About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails
A. About Tencent
 Tencent is a leading global technology and entertainment company focused on connecting people and developing innovative products and services. Founded in 1998 and publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2004, Tencent’s communication and social services, entertainment (video games, music, sports, and film/TV), fintech, cloud, and enterprise solutions are used by hundreds of millions of people around the world.
 Tencent has been recognized as one of the “World’s Best Employers” (Forbes), including as one of the “Best Workplaces for New Graduates” (2026); one of the “World’s Most Admired Companies” (Fortune); and one of the “World’s Best Companies” (Time). In addition to its headquarters in Shenzhen, Tencent maintains offices across Asia, Europe, North America, and Latin America, including Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Palo Alto, Los Angeles, New York, and Washington, D.C. To learn more about the company, visit www.Tencent.com (About Us). 
 B. About the Role
 Tencent is seeking a highly motivated Associate, Global AI Policy to join its Global Public Affairs team in Palo Alto. This early-career position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, public policy, technology, and international affairs.
 The Associate will support Tencent's global AI policy efforts by researching emerging policy developments, monitoring legislative and regulatory activity, analyzing technology trends, and helping develop insights for Tencent businesses. The role will work closely with colleagues across public affairs, legal, compliance, and AI and Cloud product teams, while also engaging with external stakeholders including policymakers, think tanks, industry associations, academic institutions, and civil society organizations.
 While the position will be based in Palo Alto, the successful candidate will contribute to Tencent's assessment and understanding of broader AI trends globally, including the US but also Europe, Asia-Pacific, etc.Policy Research & Analysis
Monitor and analyze developments related to artificial intelligence, including machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, semiconductors, and other emerging technologies.
Track and assess industry initiatives and policy developments in the United States and other key international markets.
Prepare concise policy briefings, research memoranda, presentations, and executive summaries for internal stakeholders.
Support analysis of AI policy trends and their potential implications for Tencent's business and technology strategy.
Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and policy developments relevant to Tencent's AI and cloud businesses.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with internal teams across public affairs, legal, compliance, product, engineering, and research functions.
Assist with the development of policy positions, consultation responses, and external-facing materials.
Support preparation for meetings, conferences, speaking engagements, and policy discussions.
Stakeholder Engagement
Assist in managing relationships with think tanks, academic institutions, trade associations, and policy organizations.
Support Tencent's participation in AI policy forums, conferences, workshops, and industry events.
Help coordinate internal and external meetings and maintain stakeholder engagement databases and tracking tools.

Who We Look For
We are looking for an intellectually curious individual who enjoys learning about complex issues and translating them into clear insights for business and policy teams. title: 腾讯云日本销售经理｜テンセントクラウドセールスマネージャー（日本）
description:
部署紹介/Business Unit

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
工作内容：
1、负责腾讯云日本市场的业务拓展与销售达成，统筹渠道生态与直销双线推进，完成年度销售业绩目标；

3、直销线：独立负责日本市场头部客户（含大型企业、互联网公司及政企客户）的开拓与攻坚，主导全销售周期——从客户识别、需求洞察、方案设计到商务谈判与签约落地；
4、建立并维护与重点渠道伙伴及直销客户的长期合作关系，构建稳定的客户沟通及经营复盘机制，持续深耕客户价值，推动增购与交叉销售；
5、制定日本区域的"作战地图"，系统性拓展新合作伙伴及直销目标客户，管理完整的销售Pipeline，持续推动新商机的挖掘与转化；
6、整合公司内部资源（产品、解决方案、售前、交付等），推动解决渠道伙伴及直销客户在销售转化中的关键问题，持续优化销售流程与客户体验；
7、跟踪日本云计算市场动态及竞对策略，输出市场洞察，为业务决策及产品本地化提供一线输入。
仕事内容
1.テンセントクラウド日本におけるビジネス開発および売上目標を達成するため、チャネルエコシステムとダイレクトセールスの両輪を統括的に推進し、年度売上目標を完遂する。
2.チャネル：NTT DATA、CTC、TISなどの大手システムインテグレーター（SI）を含む中核パートナーを中心に、戦略方向性および売上目標をすり合わせ、チャネル成長計画を策定。パートナーの育成（イネブルメント）、研修・認定、インセンティブ政策、商談転換の着地を推進する。
3.ダイレクトセールス：日本市場の大手顧客（大手企業、インターネット企業、官公庁・企業顧客を含む）の開拓・深耕を単独で担当。顧客の特定、ニーズ把握、提案設計から商談交渉、契約着地まで、セールス全工程をリードする。
4.キーチャネルパートナーおよびダイレクトセールス顧客との長期的な協力関係を構築・維持し、安定した顧客コミュニケーションおよび運営振返りの仕組みを構築。継続的に顧客価値を深耕し、増枠購入およびクロスセルの推進を図る。
5.日本地域の「作戦マップ」を策定し、体系的に新規パートナーおよびダイレクトセールス目標顧客を拡大。完全なセールスパイプラインを管理し、新規商談の発掘と転換を継続的に推進する。
6.社内リソース（製品、ソリューション、プリセールス、デリバリー等）を統合し、チャネルパートナーおよびダイレクトセールス顧客がセールス転換において直面する肝要課題の解決を推進し、セールスプロセスおよび顧客体験を継続的に最適化する。
7.日本クラウドコンピューティング市場の動向および競合戦略を追跡し、市場インサイトをアウトプット。ビジネス意思決定および製品のローカライゼーションに現場のインプットを提供する。

応募資格/Who We Look For
能力要求
1、本科及以上学历，5年以上云计算或ICT行业销售经验，同时具备渠道拓展与直销/大客户销售实战经验；
2、熟悉日本云计算市场及商业生态，具备与大型系统集成商（SI）合作经验（如NTT DATA、CTC、TIS、SCSK、日立系等），同时有日本大型企业/政企客户直销经验者优先，理解其采购决策流程及组织架构；
3、对云计算产品、解决方案及行业应用有深入理解，具备完整的端到端销售闭环经验（渠道及直销均可），有千万级以上 deal 签约的成功案例；

7、可接受日本国内及跨国出差
能力要件
1.大卒以上。クラウドコンピューティングまたはICT業界における5年以上のセールス実務経験を有し、チャネル開拓とダイレクトセールス／大手顧客セールスの両方の実戦経験を併せ持つこと。

title: Data Product Intern 107644
description:

Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
Responsibilities：
1. Establishing overseas data product system, including: AI Agent, data BI, data analysis, self-service analysis and other data application platform by communicating with global game R&D Studios and analysing global game data and application scenario features.
2. Coordinating with Dev&Design teams, controlling project implementation and final results, optimizing products design and operation to achieve game data solution value.
3. Communicate and connect with customers, understand their needs, and provide targeted solutions.

Who We Look For

5. Excellent logical thinking and analytical skills, love game industry, strong anti-stress ability and self-drive, entrepreneurial spirit, and ability to grow quickly.
6. Proficiency in both English and Mandarian will be a plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: 混元Agent后训练算法工程师（北京/上海/深圳）
description:
1.Agent 后训练算法设计与实现：主导基模大模型的 Agent 化后训练方案研发，包括指令微调（SFT）、奖励模型（RM）训练、强化学习（RLHF/RLAIF）优化，聚焦任务规划、记忆机制、工具调用、多轮对话一致性等核心能力提升。​；
2.后训练数据体系构建：设计 Agent 后训练数据的采集、清洗、标注与迭代策略，涵盖通用指令集、任务型对话数据、工具调用样本、多模态交互数据等，建立数据质量评估与筛选机制，优化数据分布与多样性。​；
3.Agent 能力优化与突破：针对 Agent 在复杂任务拆解、跨领域知识迁移、动态环境适配等场景的痛点，研发创新后训练算法（如分层任务规划训练、多智能体协作训练、反幻觉优化），提升 Agent 的决策准确性与鲁棒性。​；
4.工程化落地与系统协作：搭建高高效后训练流水线，支持大规模数据并行处理、分布式训练（DDP/FSDP）与模型压缩部署；与产品、工程团队协作，打通 “后训练 - 评测 - 迭代” 闭环，适配不同场景下的 Agent 产品需求。​；
5.技术创新与沉淀：跟踪大模型 Agent 领域前沿技术（如 LLM+Planning、Tool Learning、Multi-Agent Interaction），主导核心技术攻关与专利申请；输出可复用的后训练算法组件、技术文档与评测基准，推动团队技术能力沉淀。
requirement:
1.计算机科学、人工智能、机器学习等相关专业硕士及以上学历，1年以上大模型后训练或 Agent 相关研发经验。​；
2.扎实的算法基础：精通深度学习、强化学习、自然语言处理核心理论，深入理解大模型训练原理、Transformer 架构及 Agent 决策机制。​；
3.工程能力扎实：熟练掌握 Python 编程语言，精通 PyTorch/TensorFlow 框架及 HuggingFace 生态，具备大规模数据处理（Spark/Flink）与分布式训练（DDP/FSDP/DeepSpeed）实战经验。​；
4.后训练实战经验：具备大模型指令微调、RLHF/RLAIF、奖励模型训练等后训练全流程经验，熟悉 Agent 任务规划、工具调用等核心场景的训练优化方法。​。

title: 混元VLM 预训练数据算法工程师（北京/深圳/上海）
description:
1.多模态数据体系构建：设计并实现 VLM 预训练数据的采集、清洗、标注全流程方案，涵盖通用图文对、OCR 数据、Visual Grounding/Counting 数据、3D 空间理解数据及视频时序数据等多类型数据，建立数据质量评估体系（如 CLIP 相似度过滤、标注一致性校验）。​；
2.数据算法创新设计：研发多模态数据对齐算法，优化视觉 - 语言模态映射策略；设计高效数据增强方案，包括图像形变、文本扰动、跨模态混合增强等，提升模型鲁棒性与场景适应性；探索自动标注与数据合成技术（如 Grounding DINO 自动框标注、LLM 辅助问答生成），降低标注成本。​；
3.预训练数据策略优化：结合 VLM 预训练目标（模态对齐、上下文学习、复杂推理），设计数据配比方案与训练数据筛选策略；迭代优化数据配方，解决数据冗余、分布偏差等问题，提升训练效率与模型效果。​；
4.工程化落地与协作：搭建高吞吐率数据处理流水线，支持大规模多模态数据的并行处理与分布式训练适配；与模型训练团队协作，打通数据 - 训练 - 评测闭环，提供定制化数据解决方案；跟进 NVILA、InternVL 等前沿技术，推动数据算法的工程化落地。​；
5.技术沉淀与创新：跟踪 VLM 领域数据相关前沿研究（如预训练数据设计、模态融合策略），主导技术攻关与专利申请；输出可复用的数据处理算法组件与技术文档，建立团队数据算法基准体系。
requirement:
1.计算机科学、人工智能、自动化等相关专业硕士及以上学历，1年以上多模态大模型或计算机视觉领域研发经验。​；
2.扎实的算法基础：精通深度学习、计算机视觉与自然语言处理核心理论，深入理解 Transformer 架构、模态对齐原理及多模态预训练机制。​；
3.工程能力突出：熟练掌握 Python 编程语言，精通 PyTorch 框架及 HuggingFace 生态，具备大规模数据处理（Spark/Flink）与分布式训练（DDP/FSDP/DeepSpeed）经验。​；
4.数据处理实战经验：具备 VLM 预训练数据构建全流程经验，熟悉图像去重、图文匹配、自动标注、数据增强等关键技术，有亿级规模多模态数据集构建案例者优先。

title: Data Engineer Intern 107681
description:
Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

1. Responsible for the raw data pipeline for all Tencent overseas games, ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficiency.
2. Collaborate closely with upstream engineering teams to optimize data ingestion, processing, and storage.
3. Partner effectively with downstream stakeholders, including data analysts, data scientists, and ML engineers, to enable data-driven decision-making and advanced analytics.

Who We Look For

4. Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Java, Scala, Python, Go or equivalent).

7. You are self-directed and capable of operating amidst ambiguity.
8. You are humble, continually growing in self-awareness, and possessing a growth mindset.
9. You are curious and have excellent written and verbal communication as well as problem-solving skills. 
10. Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin to engage with stakeholders from HQ and international teams is a plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

·Experience collaborating with cross-functional or global teams is preferred; professional proficiency in Mandarin is a plus to help facilitate communication with our international offices.
Location State(s)

WorkSolo is a professional creation tool built for AI creators. It empowers independent creators, studios, and creative professionals with AI-native workflows to ideate, produce, and publish high-quality content — from concept to final output. As we expand globally, we're looking for a creative and technically fluent AI Script Editor to help define what great AI-generated storytelling looks like for international audiences.Key Responsibilities:

- Document and share skill learnings to build a scalable creative knowledge base for the team
Content Quality & Localization

- Serve as the creative quality bar-raiser — reviewing, editing, and elevating AI-generated scripts to professional production standards

Qualifications- 1–5 years of screenwriting experience for overseas short dramas, films, or series; at least one produced and released overseas project required

title: 《逆战：未来》玩法策划

5.抗压能力强，能适应版本节点冲刺节奏。

title: 买量增长运营

title: AI ⽹络集合通信库运营⼯程师
description:
1.通信库运营保障：负责集合通信库（如 NCCL 等）在⼤规模 AI 训练/推理集群中的部署、配置、升级与⽇常运营，确保通信服务的⾼可⽤性和性能达标；
2.性能监控与优化：建设通信性能监控体系，持续跟踪 AllReduce/AllGather/All-to-All 等关键通信算⼦的带宽和延迟指标，识别性能退化并驱动优化；
3.故障诊断与恢复：快速响应训练 hang、通信超时、性能下降等故障，具备从业务现象出发逐层定位到通信库、传输层、硬件层根因的能⼒，缩短 MTTR；
4.业务⽀撑协同：与上层训练/推理框架团队紧密协作，理解不同并⾏策略（TP/PP/DP/EP/CP）对通信的需求，提供通信层⾯的调优建议；
5.⼯具与⾃动化建设：参与或主导通信诊断⼯具、⾃动化巡检、异常检测等运营⼯具的开发，提升运营效率和故障⾃愈能⼒；
6.容量规划与技术演进：根据业务增⻓和新硬件（NVLink/InfiniBand/RoCE）的引⼊，参与集群通信架构规划和通信库版本选型评估。
requirement:
一.基本要求；
1.计算机科学、通信⼯程、电⼦⼯程或相关专业，本科及以上学历；
2.两年以上相关⼯作经验（集合通信库开发、HPC 通信优化、AI 基础设施运营等⽅向均可）；
二、专业技能；
1.集合通信原理：深⼊理解集合通信算⼦（AllReduce、AllGather、ReduceScatter、All-to-All 等）的原理和实现算法（Ring、Tree、Double Binary Tree 等），了解算法选择对性能的影响；
2.通信库实践：熟悉 NCCL 架构（Channel、Protocol、Transport、Proxy 等核⼼模块），有 NCCL 调优、问题排查或⼆次开发经验者优先；了解 DeepEP、Gloo、MSCCL 等其他通信库者加分；
3.底层通信机制：理解 GPU 机内通信机制（NVLink、NVSwitch、PCIe P2P、DMA、GPU Direct RDMA），掌握RDMA 通信原理（InfiniBand 或 RoCEv2）；
4.AI 训练业务理解：了解⼤模型训练的主流并⾏策略（数据并⾏、张量并⾏、流⽔线并⾏、专家并⾏等），能理解不同并⾏模式对通信的带宽和延迟需求；
5.系统与⼯具：熟悉 Linux 系统环境，能熟练使⽤ nvidia-smi、DCGM、nccl-tests、Nsight Systems 等诊断⼯具；
6.编程能⼒：熟练掌握Python/go/bash等之⼀，熟悉AI辅助编程⼯具，具备阅读和修改通信库源码的能⼒；有 CUDA编程经验者优先；
三、能⼒素质；
1.问题定位能⼒：具备从业务现象到底层硬件的全栈排查思维，能在⾼压下快速缩⼩问题范围；
2.协作沟通能⼒：能与训练⼯程师、⽹络⼯程师、硬件⼯程师⾼效协同，⽤业务语⾔翻译技术问题；
3.持续学习意愿：AI 基础设施技术迭代快，需要持续跟进新硬件、新通信库版本和新并⾏范式；
4.⼯程化思维：注重⾃动化、可观测性、标准化，推动运营向。
