title: Product Manager – AI Creator Platform
description:
Business Unit
Platform & Content Group (PCG) is responsible for the company's Internet platform and the integrated development of the content and culture ecosystem. PCG integrates social platforms such as QQ and QZone with traffic platforms such as Tencent's App Store and browsers, as well as content platforms including news, videos, sports, live broadcasts, animes and movies to develop a better growth environment for Tencent's content ecosystem. PCG promotes the cross-platform and multi-modal development of IP, with the overall goal of creating more diversified premium digital content experiences for more users.

What the Role Entails
About WorkSolo
WorkSolo is a professional creation tool built for AI creators. It empowers independent creators, studios, and creative professionals with AI-native workflows to ideate, produce, and publish high-quality content — from concept to final output. As we scale internationally, we're looking for a seasoned product manager to shape WorkSolo's product vision, roadmap, and creator experience for global markets.Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Own the product strategy and roadmap for WorkSolo's overseas markets, aligning HQ vision with local creator needs
Define product North Star metrics and success criteria (activation, retention, creation depth, publish-through rate, monetization)
Translate market insights, competitive intelligence, and creator behavior trends into prioritized product bets
AI-Native Feature Design
Lead end-to-end product design for AI creation workflows — covering ideation, generation, editing, collaboration, and publishing
Define and ship features around multimodal generation (text-to-image, text-to-video, voice, 3D), agentic workflows, asset management, and creator monetization
Partner with AI/ML, design, and engineering teams to ship high-quality experiences at startup speed
User Research & Market Insight
Build a continuous discovery system: creator interviews, usability studies, community listening, and quantitative analysis
Synthesize insights from Discord, Reddit, X/Twitter, YouTube, and TikTok creator ecosystems into product requirements
Develop deep personas for AI creators (independents, studios, professional creatives) and map their end-to-end workflows
Localization & Market Fit
Drive product localization strategy across language, payment, content policy, and creator economics for key markets (North America, EU, JP/KR, SEA, LATAM)
Define market-specific feature variants, onboarding flows, and pricing/packaging in collaboration with operations and growth
Champion the international user's voice within HQ; influence the global product roadmap with regional priorities
Data & Experimentation
Build a rigorous experimentation culture: hypothesis → A/B test → learning loops
Define instrumentation requirements and partner with data teams on dashboards, funnels, and cohort analysis
Use analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, etc.) to monitor product health and identify growth levers
AIGC Ecosystem & Partnerships
Stay at the forefront of the global AI creator tools ecosystem (workflows, toolchains, emerging models, and creator behavior trends)
Identify integration and partnership opportunities with model providers, distribution platforms, and creator ecosystems
Represent WorkSolo at industry events, creator conferences, and AIGC community gatherings
Cross-Functional Leadership
Lead cross-functional squads of engineers, designers, researchers, and data scientists across HQ (China) and LA
Own clear written PRDs, specs, and trade-off rationales; drive alignment across time zones
Collaborate closely with overseas operations, marketing, and BD to ensure go-to-market readiness

Who We Look For
Qualifications5–8 years of product management experience, ideally within creator tools, AIGC platforms, content/media, or developer-facing creative products
Proven track record shipping consumer or prosumer products at scale in international markets
Deep familiarity with the global AI creator tools landscape — including generation tools (Midjourney, Runway, Pika, Kling, Sora), creation workflow tools (Notion AI, Canva AI, Adobe Firefly, CapCut), and creator platform ecosystems (YouTube Studio, TikTok Creator Marketplace, Patreon, Substack)
Hands-on experience designing AI-native features (prompting UX, multimodal generation, agentic workflows, model orchestration) is strongly preferred
Strong data literacy; comfortable defining metrics, designing experiments, and using analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, SQL)
Experience operating across Western social platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, X) and understanding how AI creators discover, adopt, and evangelize creation tools
Excellent written and verbal English communication; Mandarin Chinese is a strong plus for HQ collaboration
Self-starter with startup mentality; comfortable operating with ambiguity, time-zone span, and the speed of an early-stage international expansion
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Design, HCI, Media, or a related field; equivalent practical experience welcome
Nice to HavePrior experience launching products from 0 → 1 in overseas markets
Personal creator background or active participation in AIGC creator communities
Familiarity with creator monetization models (subscriptions, marketplaces, revenue share, tipping)
Experience working across China–US dual-HQ structures
Location State(s)
US-California-Los Angeles

The Employee is also eligible for up to 15 to 25 days of vacation per year (depending on the employee’s tenure), up to 13 days of holidays throughout the calendar year, and up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
Your benefits may be adjusted to reflect your location, employment status, duration of employment with the company, and position level. Benefits may also be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (Overseas Advertising Platform & Public Welfare Projects Compliance)
description:
What the Role Entails
Tencent is looking for a Senior Legal Counsel focusing on overseas advertising platform and public welfare initiatives. As one of the key members in the Tencent overseas legal team, you will have an exciting opportunity to support international business, products and platforms in the areas of advertising, open-source software and AI across multiple jurisdictions.
Key Responsibilities
Advise on the legal and compliance aspects of overseas advertising platforms, including product features, platform governance, advertiser onboarding, ad review workflows, user-facing disclosures, and cross-border launches
Build and improve the compliance framework for the overseas advertising business, including policies, standard operating procedures, risk assessments, approval workflows, training, and knowledge management.
Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including advertiser, agency, ad-tech, vendor, media-buying, and platform service agreements, as well as data-related and general commercial contracts.
Conduct legal assessments and market entry research covering advertising and marketing regulation, consumer protection, privacy and data protection, content moderation, and sector-specific requirements.
Provide strategic, end-to-end legal and compliance support for the global expansion and implementation of overseas public welfare initiatives, including contract review, legal risk assessment, governance support and other legal work across the project lifecycle.
Collaborate with external counsel and other Tencent attorneys based around the world, including in mainland China, Singapore, the EU, the US and other relevant jurisdictions, to provide practical compliance and regulatory analysis for international business initiatives.
Identify legal and regulatory risks early, and develop practical, scalable solutions for business, product, and platform teams.

Who We Look For
Key expectations and criteria:
Education: Exceptional academic credentials, including an advanced law degree from a prestigious, internationally recognized law school. Admission to practice in a major overseas jurisdiction is strongly preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of post-qualification experience gained at leading international law firms and/or multinational corporations. Proven experience in advertising, media, platform businesses, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and cross-border legal matters is strongly preferred.
Compliance Systems Experience: Hands-on experience in building or enhancing compliance frameworks, including policies, template documentation, approval workflows, training programs, and knowledge management tools, with the ability to drive operational efficiency in line with both international standards and local regulatory requirements.
Business Judgment: Sound business acumen with the ability to deliver practical, commercially pragmatic, and comprehensive legal advice in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to build trusted, effective relationships with business stakeholders across different functions and levels.
Independence & Project Management: Ability to work independently, effectively prioritize competing demands, and manage end-to-end project processes—from initial legal assessment and contract negotiation through to implementation and post-launch risk management.
Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable operating under pressure in a fast-paced, constantly evolving technology environment, with the ability to handle complex, time-sensitive, and multi-jurisdictional matters.
Learning Agility: Quick learner with a genuine interest in the latest developments in overseas advertising regulation, platform compliance, and emerging technologies.
Language: Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English (written and spoken) as working languages.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: China-Shenzhen | Hong Kong

1.与大模型算法同学深度合作，联合优化，打造行业领先的高性能推理引擎，支持LLM/VLM/DiT等模型的高效部署；
2.推理性能极致优化、包括PD分离、低比特计算、并行优化、算子优化等，提升大规模分布式推理系统的整体效率；
3.支持主流GPU和异构AI芯片，优化大模型推理性能，打造极致性能成本优势。
requirement:
1.熟练掌握C/C++、Python编程语言，具备良好的coding和调试能力；
2.熟悉主流大模型推理框架，如vllm，sglang，tensorrt-llm等，具备语言、多模态模型大规模部署和优化经验；
3.熟悉并行策略，如数据并行、流水线并行等，熟悉NVLINK、GPU RDMA通信者优先；
4.熟悉各类深度学习网络和算子底层实现细节，有实操经验优先；
5.熟悉主流开源模型及其架构特点，具备针对不同模型进行分析优化的能力优先；
6.具备GPU、AI芯片体系结构知识，熟悉芯片特性，具备系统性能分析和调优经验优先。

title: 腾讯游戏-大模型智能评测算法工程师
description:
1.负责游戏视频生成大模型/世界大模型/数字人大模型的智能评测体系（标准/BMK/算子）构建，以评测提升大模型效果/安全提升；
2.持续优化大模型的智能评测技术体系，包括但不限于SFT/RL/CPT/MoE/Agent等技术，以此来提升智能评测效率和置信度；
3.负责将智能评测技术应用于大模型的训练/评测数据处理和质量优化中，提高训练/评测数据处理效率和质量，进而提升大模型迭代效率和效果；
4.紧跟业界和学术界智能评测前沿，发现其亮点和前进动态，借此不断完善现有智能评测体系。
requirement:
1.具备扎实的视频/NLP/多模态领域算法基础，能深刻理解大模型的基本原理（transformer架构、预训练、后训练等）；
2.熟练掌握并实践大模型相关算法技术，包括但不限于SFT/LoRA/CPT/RL/PE等，参与过大模型（视频/图文/音频/文本）智能评测实际开发；
3.熟练掌握Pytorch/TensorFlow等主流开发框架，代码熟练且动手能力强；
4.具备良好的逻辑思维能力和数据处理能力，善于发现问题并提出系统性解决方案，具备良好的团队协作精神。

title: 腾讯游戏-高性能算子优化工程师/专家
description:
1.负责大模型训练/推理相关算子的设计、实现与优化（ CUDA/CUTLASS/Triton ）；
2.面向大模型训练和推理场景，对算子进行端到端性能分析与调优，持续挖掘吞吐、延迟、显存利用率等指标的优化空间；
3.参与或主导训推场景通信算子性能优化，能够设计通信与计算的overlap策略，实现计算通信并行，提升大模型整体训练/推理性能；
4.与分布式训练、推理、模型算法团队密切协作，共同提升大规模训推任务的整体效率与稳定性；
5.跟踪业界前沿的硬件架构与系统软件（GPU 架构、网络、编译器、库等），将最新技术转化为实际性能收益。
requirement:
1.计算机、软件工程、数学、电子信息、自动化等相关专业，本科及以上学历；
2.扎实的编程基础，熟练使用 C/C++，对代码质量与工程实践有较高要求；
3.熟练掌握 GPU 编程，有实际 CUDA 开发经验；熟悉 CUTLASS、Triton 等任一或多种算子开发/优化框架；
4.熟悉并行计算原理，对 GPU 体系结构（SM、Warp、Memory Hierarchy、Occupancy 等）有较深入理解；
5.熟悉分布式并行原理，能够设计和实现大模型训练/推理场景下的高效集合通信算子和通算融合算子；
6.具备良好的问题定位与性能分析能力，能熟练使用 Nsight、nvprof、perf 等性能分析工具进行瓶颈分析和优化。

title: 预研项目-高级技术美术(UE5材质灯光方向)
description:
1.为虚幻引擎设计材质渲染方案，编写Shader，制作特殊贴图，实现美术效果；
2.为游戏内场景和角色布置灯光，以提升视觉效果和营造氛围；
3.搭建游戏场景的环境氛围，天气系统，TOD，相机后处理等；
4.搭建Lookdev环境，确保美术资产在不同光照环境下的效果表现；
5.和美术团队充分合作，解决材质、灯光、工具、性能等研发和生产中遇到的问题；
6.编写并维护技术文档，向美术推广新工具和最佳实践。
requirement:
1.5年以上游戏开发经验，3年以上UE使用经验，有国风项目经验者优先；
2.具有优秀的美术审美，熟悉摄影、色彩和物理灯光等相关知识，了解PBR理论；
3.丰富的游戏角色渲染效果制作经验，熟悉主流游戏角色相关材质渲染方案；
4.熟悉实时渲染管线，掌握HLSL等Shader编程语言，能够编写高效可维护的Shader代码；
5.具备优秀的打光能力，有离线烘培、TOD动态照明、色彩校正和后处理制作等能力；
6.精通DCC软件（3dsmax/Maya，SD/SP等），能输出相关美术资产辅助材质和灯光的制作；
7.善于沟通，做事高标准，热爱游戏，对游戏前沿技术有热情。

title: 魔方工作室-动作生成算法工程师-角色动画方向
description:
1.动作生成算法研发：设计与落地骨骼动画的生成与控制算法，覆盖locomotion、交互、战斗、过渡（in-betweening）等场景，兼顾动作质量、响应性与可控性；
2.前沿方案调研与选型：跟踪并复现业界主流与最新方案（如 PFNN / MANN、Motion Matching及 Learned Motion Matching、Motion Diffusion Model 系列、自回归运动扩散、Flow Matching文本到动作等），结合项目需求做技术选型与优化；
3.物理动画与神经网络结合：探索物理仿真与学习方法的融合（如 DeepMimic / AMP / ASE强化学习控制、物理引导扩散 PhysDiff / Diffuse-CLoC / PDP等），提升动作的物理合理性与鲁棒性；
4.控制信号与可控生成：构建轨迹、目标点、文本、末端约束等条件信号到动作的映射与对齐，支持交互式、实时的动作控制；
5.引擎集成与端侧部署：将动作模型集成进游戏引擎，完成推理加速、量化裁剪与端侧（移动端/ PC）部署，保障运行时性能与内存预算；
6.工具与插件开发：在游戏引擎与 DCC 软件中开发动作相关工具与插件，打通数据采集、清洗、训练到运行时的工程链路，提升迭代效率。
requirement:
1.计算机 / 数学 / 图形学 / 自动化相关本科及以上；3年以上角色动画、动作生成或相关算法研发经验；
2.有骨骼动画生成与控制的实际项目经验，熟悉业界方案（PFNN、MANN、Motion Matching等），了解基于扩散 / VAE / Flow Matching 等生成式动作方法；
3.熟悉物理动画与神经网络结合的方法，理解物理仿真、强化学习在角色控制中的应用；
4.熟悉游戏引擎与 DCC 软件的使用及动作插件编写，熟悉 UE 动画蓝图（Animation Blueprint）与Unity 动画状态机（Animator / Mecanim），掌握 IK / FK、动画重定向、混合空间等方法；
5.熟悉动作模型的训练全流程，具备在引擎内进行端侧部署与推理优化的经验；

title: International Regulatory Senior Counsel
description:
Business Unit
The S1 Legal & Administration Line functions as the backbone support system for corporate security, legal affairs, government affairs, administrative affairs, procurement, infrastructure, and corporate social responsibility.

What the Role Entails
Serve as regulatory counsel for the company’s cloud and content businesses in market, owning end-to-end regulatory and compliance strategy, with a particular focus on license and permit applications, statutory registrations, and the localization, gap-analysis and implementation of newly enacted laws across relevant jurisdictions.
Partner closely with business teams to understand product roadmaps, deal structures and go-to-market plans; identify regulatory exposures in advance, and deliver practical, business-aligned legal advice through regular on-site engagement with local commercial, product and policy stakeholders.
Monitor, interpret and operationalize regulatory developments across Southeast Asia, translate them into actionable internal guidance, and lead the rollout of localized compliance frameworks, policies and training programs.
Lead the company’s response to regulatory inquiries, administrative reviews, enforcement actions and investigations initiated by authorities in the region, coordinating with internal stakeholders, external counsel and, where required, law enforcement counterparts.
Manage and oversee relationships with local external counsel and regulators across the region, serving as the principal point of contact for engagement with authorities on cloud, content and broader regulatory matters, and supporting government-relations colleagues in substantive policy dialogue.
Act as the company’s designated regional regulatory counsel for Southeast Asia, providing regulatory coverage and strategic guidance on cross-business and cross-jurisdictional matters that extend across all business groups.

Who We Look For
Bachelor of Laws or equivalent degree from a reputable institution; admitted to practice and holding an active lawyer’s license in at least one jurisdiction.
5 - 10 years PQE with a demonstrated track record in regulatory and compliance work, either in-house at a multinational corporation (preferably a Chinese-headquartered technology or internet company) or at a top-tier international law firm advising technology clients on regulatory matters.
Solid working knowledge of the Southeast Asian regulatory landscape with hands-on experience.
Experience in regulatory investigations, enforcement actions or government engagement, with sound judgment under pressure and discretion in handling sensitive matters.
Strong product sense and genuine curiosity about cloud, content and internet business models, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance for product, commercial and policy stakeholders.
Proven ability to partner with business teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment; comfortable engaging with senior leaders and operating effectively across cross-functional settings, with a strong willingness to be on-site with business teams and regulators as required.
Bilingual fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese (written and oral) is required; proficiency in an additional Southeast Asian language is a plus.
Self-driven, organized and resilient; able to independently manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities and time-sensitive regulatory deadlines across multiple jurisdictions.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

5.对游戏行业充满热情，对品质有极高追求，能够在压力下按时保质完成任务。

title: 3D 场景地编负责人

title: Senior Anti-Fraud Strategy Engineer
description:
Business Unit
Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Key Responsibilities
Strategy Development: Develop and iterate end-to-end anti-fraud strategies for the overseas AdN, covering pre-bid, in-flight, and post-event phases. Target various fraud schemes (e.g., IVT, click farms) across multiple ad formats.
Advanced Analytics & AI: Leverage distributed data platforms and large-scale models (LLMs) to conduct in-depth mining of ad events. Integrate AI technologies to achieve precise risk identification, extract high-value features, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
Performance Optimization: Define and track core anti-fraud KPIs. Optimize strategy precision through A/B testing to balance fraud prevention with legitimate traffic growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Business teams to deploy strategies into real-time risk engines, ensuring low latency and alignment with business goals.
Industry Monitoring: Monitor global ad fraud trends and industry standards; proactively adjust strategies to counter emerging threats in key overseas markets.
Ecosystem Health: Manage fraud-related disputes with publishers and advertisers. Collaborate to promote anti-fraud best practices and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations.

Who We Look For
Technical Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
3-5+ years of hands-on experience in anti-fraud strategy, traffic quality, or risk management within the mobile ad tech industry.
Strong data processing and analysis capabilities with familiarity in distributed data platforms. Proficiency in SQL and Python is required; experience with LLM applications is a strong advantage.
In-depth understanding of the mobile ad ecosystem, attribution logic, monetization models, and industry standards (e.g., IAB).
Deep understanding of various ad fraud tactics and verifiable experience in designing anti-fraud strategies and AI-driven risk identification.
Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to collaborate effectively with global teams and stakeholders.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills; able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience in overseas ad business or AdN operations at top-tier tech companies.
Deep understanding of AI/ML technologies for fraud detection, with practical experience in innovative AI applications.
Familiarity with real-time stream processing frameworks (e.g., Flink, Kafka), rule engines, or big data platforms.
Experience in game ad monetization or app ecosystems; TAG certification or compliance experience is preferred.

title: Game Design Intern — Rapid Prototyping 107688
description:
Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

What the Role Entails
About the role We're an incubation team inside Lightspeed Studios chasing original IP with high replayability value. We move fast: idea → playable prototype → playtest → next idea. We're looking for an intern who can sit at the intersection of design and code, turning gameplay hypotheses into things people can actually click on within days, not weeks.
 
关于这个岗位
我们是光子旗下的一个孵化团队,专注于挖掘有原创 IP 潜质、高耐玩度的游戏方向。
节奏很快:想法 → 可玩原型 → 试玩 → 下一个想法。我们想找一位能在策划和开发之间游走的实习生，能把脑子里的玩法概念，几天内变成大家能上手玩的东西，而不是花上几周。
This is not a production role. The bar is "fun enough to validate," not "ready to ship." If you've spent weekends building prototypes for game jams just to see whether a weird mechanic works, you'll feel at home here.
这不是量产岗位。我们的标准是"好玩到能验证方向"，而不是"可以上线发售"。如果你周末闲不下来，经常做点 Game Jam 原型，就为了看看一个怪点子能不能 work，那你来对地方了。
 
What you'll do
Design and prototype gameplay mechanics across genres, with a focus on replayability and IP potential
Spin up playable web prototypes in Phaser.js / HTML5 / JS — fast, dirty, and instructive
Run informal playtests with the team, distil what's fun (and what isn't), and feed findings back into the next iteration
Produce light design docs — enough to communicate intent, not enough to drown in
Collaborate with the design lead on weekly experiments aligned to incubation themes
你会做什么
跨品类设计并原型化玩法机制,重点验证耐玩度和 IP 潜力
用 Phaser.js / HTML5 / JS 快速搭建网页端可玩原型 — 快、糙、有效
在团队内组织非正式试玩,提炼出"什么好玩、什么不好玩"，反哺下一轮迭代
写轻量级的设计文档 — 把思路讲清楚即可,不用堆字数
跟策划 Lead 配合，围绕孵化主题做每周的玩法实验

description:

3.提高大模型可靠性：致力于大幅度降低多模态大模型幻觉。深入探究幻觉产生的本质，建设完善的幻觉检测链路，实施精细化的数据清洗策略，并主导研发基于强化学习的幻觉消除（Hallucination Removal）方案；
4.赋能用户交互场景：面向真实用户场景进行模型对齐与调优，强化模型在多轮图文交互中的逻辑推理、指令遵循（Instruction Following）以及细节感知能力。搭建线上 Badcase 监控与数据飞轮反馈闭环，持续打磨并打造极致的交互体验。
requirement:

2.深入理解 Transformer 架构及大语言模型训练原理，在 LLM Alignment、RLHF、Reward Modeling、个性化大模型（Personalized LLM）、记忆机制（Memory/RAG）等后训练领域之一有深入的研究和实践经验；

5.拥有分布式训练实战经验，熟悉 Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, vLLM 等大规模训练及推理框架，有百亿/千亿参数模型训练或调优经验者优先；
6.具备优秀的科研素养，有高质量论文发表（NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 等）或在开源社区（如 HuggingFace）有高影响力项目贡献者优先；

title: Game User Research Intern 107751
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for an early career game user research intern who is passionate about video games to join our Games User Research team in central London. This is a great opportunity to gain industry experience, work across many genres and learn from seasoned industry experts.
Joining Tencent Games, you will work alongside award winning studios, making some of the most popular games in the world. Your mission will be to support these studios to deliver on their intended experience by providing timely insights from members of their target audience.
Please note that this opportunity requires you to be in our Shoreditch office full time. Most of our research is conducted in person, in a dedicated lab.
1. Assist senior researchers in delivering end-to-end research projects using methods such as in-depth interviews, usability tests, multi-day playtests, diary studies, heuristic reviews or surveys.
2. Assist projects and gain experience on every phase of a study: stakeholder engagement, preparation, fieldwork, analysis, and delivery.
3. Support preparation for data gathering, working on discussion guides and surveys.
4. Support the smooth running of our lab in London.
5. Manage participants to and around the lab and ensure unbiased feedback is being gathered.
6. Process and analyse qualitative and quantitative data from multiple sources.
7. Identify actionable insights and ensure they are communicated clearly.
8. Take on more responsibilities as you learn and grow into the role.

Who We Look For
1. Degree in human-computer interaction, psychology, sociology or a field with a relevant focus on qualitative research is preferred. Early in your career and keen to learn from the industry.
2. Good communicator, you can express complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing.
3. Comfortable adapting to dynamic situations, especially when game builds don't always behave as expected.
4. Comfortable around PCs and basic troubleshooting skills.
5. You are a gamer, up to date with a variety of genres.
6. You are passionate about games user research and assessing the player experience.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: UK-London

title: Senior Business System Analyst (Workday Financials)
description:
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. Recognized as an approved employer by esteemed organizations like ACCA, HKICPA, CIMA, CPA Australia, and CA, and certified accredited trainer with the Singapore Accountancy Commission, we provide comprehensive resources and guidance to ensure our employees remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving finance landscape. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced hire, we empower you to acquire and maintain professional qualifications, enhancing your credibility and competence in the finance domain while keeping you competitive in the ever-changing industry.

What the Role Entails

Tencent Finance is seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Analyst to join our Finance IT Management Department. This role serves as a strategic partner between Finance and Technology, responsible for the design, configuration, optimization, and support of enterprise financial and planning systems within a modern cloud environment.
The Senior Business Systems Analyst leads requirements discovery, translates business objectives into scalable system solutions, and drives continuous improvement across finance processes, integrations, data models, and reporting. The role ensures system stability, compliance, and long-term scalability while supporting enhancements, testing, and production operations in a fast-paced, global environment.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities:
Act as a subject matter expert across enterprise finance systems, supporting functional areas such as Financial Management, Procurement, Banking & Settlement, Projects, Expenses, and Supplier Management
Partner with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, develop conceptual and detailed solution designs, and configure systems to meet evolving business needs
Lead system configuration, testing, and deployment activities, supporting end-to-end delivery from design through go-live

Analyze, design, document, and validate system configurations supporting existing and new business processes, reporting, and data structures
Collaborate closely with finance leaders to understand business goals, identify gaps, and recommend system-driven improvements
Facilitate design reviews and solution walkthroughs with functional owners, subject matter experts, and end users
Present solution options with clear trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to support informed decision-making
Drive the delivery of system enhancements, new capabilities, and enterprise transformation initiatives
Participate in change management, user enablement, and post–go-live support activities

Who We Look For
Who We Are Looking For
Self-motivated, articulate, and results-driven, with a strong commitment to customer satisfaction
Passionate about delivering modern, cloud-based enterprise solutions that unlock business value
Comfortable balancing collaboration and independence in complex, fast-moving environments
Resourceful, proactive, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of ownership
Positive, adaptable, and dependable, able to perform effectively under tight timelines
Comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth organizations

Qualifications
5+ years of experience working with enterprise financial or ERP platforms, including solution design, configuration, implementation, and production support (Workday Financials is strongly prefered)
Deep understanding of finance and planning domains, including core financial management, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, projects, expenses, and supplier management
Strong experience translating business and functional requirements into sustainable, scalable system solutions
Proven expertise across the full application development lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, and support
Experience delivering large-scale ERP or enterprise cloud transformation initiatives
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively across geographies, time zones, and cross-functional teams
Experience integrating ERP or finance platforms with third-party systems
Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to change and manage competing priorities
Strong technical project leadership and stakeholder management skills
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Cloud & AI Solution Architect
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Technical Consulting & Enablement: Provide professional services, including business technology consultation, cloud solution training, and technical enablement to support Tencent Cloud’s international business growth.
Solution Design & Migration: Collaborate with international architects and partners to design architecture on the Tencent Cloud platform. Guide customers and partners through system migration to the cloud, offering expertise in application and data migration, and supporting the development of applications and services on our platform.
Pre-sales & Project Coordination: Coordinate cross-functional resources from product, service, and operations teams to provide robust pre-sales technical support for key partner projects and strategic opportunities.
Ecosystem & Knowledge Development: Participate in building and structuring Tencent Cloud’s global technology partner ecosystem. Contribute by summarizing and documenting technical solutions and industry-specific use cases.

Who We Look For
Education & Core Experience: A Bachelor’s degree or higher, with over 5 years of hands-on experience in public or private cloud environments, and a solid understanding of technologies and solutions from major cloud providers.
Technical Breadth: Professional experience in at least two of the following domains: Software Development (proficient in Java, Python, or similar), System Operations & Maintenance, System Integration, Solution Design, Technical Consulting, Enterprise IT Systems & Architecture Management, Big Data, or AI.
Communication & Engagement: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and build trust with customer stakeholders at all levels—from business leaders and technical decision-makers to front-line engineers.
Mindset & Approach: A strong customer-centric mindset, a rigorous and detail-oriented work ethic, and a deep sense of responsibility. You are a proven self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and a proactive attitude.
Language Skills: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in a major European language (e.g. German, Spanish, Portuguese) and/or Mandarin Chinese is a significant plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Germany-Frankfurt

title: 高级传输系统产品架构师
description:
1.技术演进路线制定：持续跟进业界传输技术发展方向（包括但不限于传输系统，IPOD系统，相干模块），结合业务需求制定自研传输平台技术演进路线，明确短期产品研发与中长期技术布局方向，保持产品技术竞争力；
2.系统与硬件架构设计：主导自研传输平台开放光网络系统的整体架构设计，包括系统方案设计、硬件架构设计、光层/电层方案选型、设备形态规划等，输出完整的技术规格与架构设计文档，确保架构的先进性、可扩展性与成本竞争力；
3.合作伙伴研发项目管理：负责与研发合作伙伴的联合研发项目管理，制定研发里程碑与交付节点，跟进产品研发进度，协调解决研发过程中的技术与资源问题，确保研发项目按计划高质量推进；
4.产品质量管理：建立并持续完善自研平台系统质量管理体系，跟进平台系统质量指标，识别质量风险与瓶颈，推动跨团队协作进行优化改进，持续提升系统稳定性与可靠性；
5.系统测试验证：负责对设计的自研产品进行系统级测试验证，制定测试方案与验收标准，验证产品功能与性能指标，确保上线无重大质量问题发生，为产品规模化部署提供质量保障。
requirement:
1，学历与经验：
• 通信工程、电子工程、光电信息相关专业本科及以上学历，硕士优先；
• 具备 5年以上光传输/光网络领域产品研发或系统架构经验，其中至少 3 年以上系统级架构设计或产品负责人经验；
• 有大型互联网公司、运营商或设备厂商自研传输平台项目经验者优先。
2，技术能力：
• 系统架构：深入理解传输系统架构体系，熟悉开放线路系统（OLS）、白盒/灰盒设备等系统方案；具备传输系统设计定标能力
• 硬件设计：熟悉光传输设备硬件架构，包括光层器件（放大器、WSS、ROADM、光模块）、电层器件（DSP、DRIVER/TIA、FEC、成帧芯片）的选型与系统设计；
• 技术趋势：熟悉 400G/800G/1.2T 相干光通信技术演进，了解硅光（Silicon Photonics）、C/L/S波段扩展、空心光纤等前沿方向；
• 测试验证：具备光传输系统端到端测试经验，熟悉 OSNR、BER、FEC 余量、色散/非线性补偿等关键性能指标测试方法；
• 质量管理：熟悉产品全生命周期质量管理流程，具备质量风险评估、根因分析与持续改进的实操经验。
3，项目管理与协作：
• 具备跨组织/跨公司联合研发项目管理经验，能有效推动外部合作伙伴按里程碑交付；
• 具备良好的技术文档输出能力，能独立完成架构设计文档、技术规格书、测试报告等核心文档；
• 具备较强的跨团队沟通协调能力，能在多团队协作环境中推动问题闭环。
4，综合素质：
• 具备技术前瞻性判断力，能够准确把握行业技术方向并转化为可落地的技术路线；
• 具备强烈的责任心与质量意识，对产品上线质量有高标准要求；
• 具备良好的抗压能力，能在快速迭代的环境中保持技术判断的稳定性。

title: 3D动作策略游戏《虚环》-资深2D分镜师
description:

requirement:

2.丰富的游戏领域相关经验，了解游戏行业动态；

title: 3D动作游戏《狩》-游戏运营-PC渠道运营
description:

3.工作认真负责，学习能力强，沟通界面良好，合作意识强，有一定的抗压能力。

title: 3D动作游戏《狩》-游戏运营-内容生态运营
description:

4.配合产品节点，统筹内容与直播的全链路宣发落地，通过内容生态放大产品声量，助力产品用户增长与品牌建设。

1.本科及以上学历，3年以上游戏内容生态运营经验，深入理解游戏行业生态与主流内容平台的内容生态逻辑，有竞技品类项目统筹经验者优先；
2.具备内容热点敏感性，有优秀的独立策创能力；
3.有游戏内容创作/直播运作经验、游戏内容直播生态搭建经验、平台合作经验或MCN资源者优先。

title: Trust & Safety, Public Affairs & Global Policy Intern 107765
description:
About the Hiring Team
The Global Public Affairs team is committed to identifying and implementing proactive public policy positions to support the business and provide thought leadership across a number of issues, including technology, entertainment, and international trade and investment.

What the Role Entails
We are seeking a talented Trust & Safety, Public Affairs & Global Policy Intern to be part of our Global Public Affairs (GPA) team. You will be responsible for supporting the Trust & Safety team as they work on formulating, organizing, executing and communicating Trust & Safety policy programs, initiatives and positions to support the business, as well as provide thought leadership across a range of issues, including sustainability, technology, entertainment (video games), and communication.
The Trust & Safety team works closely with the Communications Team, Public Affairs Team and with Tencent’s Global Research Institute. You will work in a fast paced, global business environment. Having a collaborative and inquisitive attitude is key, along with a passion for technology and its impact on users and society. Excellent analytical, communication, and organizational skills are crucial for supportingTrut & Safety and other direct colleagues, and therefore success in this role.
The internship will be for a period of six (6) months starting August 2026, but is negotiable. We provide interns with a competitive monthly remuneration. This role is based in our Singapore HQ in Singapore.Policy Research & Analysis
Monitor global Trust & Safety policy developments (e.g., online safety bills, AI regulation, platform transparency rules) and distill implications for Tencent’s products and GPA strategy.
Conduct comparative policy benchmarking against peer companies and industry standards; prepare succinct briefs and slide decks.
​Program Support & Coordination
Help design and track project plans for Trust & Safety initiatives.
​Stakeholder Engagement Preparation
Compile Q&A libraries and scenario-based briefs to equip stakeholders for engagements.
Data Gathering & Reporting
Assist in post-mortem and after-action reviews, synthesizing lessons learned into best-practice toolkits.
Issue Monitoring
Track emerging risks on platforms (misinformation spikes, extremist content) and conduct concise risk assessments.
Cross-Functional Liaison
Support the coordination internal workshops and brainstorming sessions to foster a “safety-by-design” culture.
Administrative & Operational Support
Manage document repositories, meeting minutes, and version control for policy assets.

Who We Look For
You can commit to a minimum of 40 hours / 5 days a week to this role.
Knowledge and/or interest in working on technology policy issues and critical Trust & Safety issues at the international scale.
Collaborative and able to work well both as part of a team and independently in a global and multi-cultural environment.
Excellent communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts effectively to internal and external audience.
Superb organizational and time management skills.
Proficiency in English (written and verbal) is required, as the role involves liaising with regional and global stakeholders.
#LI-HC1

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Video Generation Content Understanding and Feedback Researcher 107784
description:
Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
1.Research the model's ability to understand generated content, parsing semantics, objects, relationships, and spatial structures.
2.Implement state tracking and consistency modeling for generated videos.
3.Explore "unified generation-understanding" model architectures.
4.Research causal consistency control and physical constraints for the "action input → video output" pipeline.
5.Research hybrid architectures to achieve low-latency feedback for real-time interactive generation.
6.Collaborate with Agent/RL teams to drive an end-to-end closed loop of "generation → understanding → control → feedback."
7.Validate controllable interactive capabilities in game scenarios and lead the establishment of evaluation systems.
8.Continuously track industry-related work and formulate proprietary technical roadmaps.

Who We Look For
1.Ph.D. in AI-related fields, covering areas such as video understanding, video prediction, reinforcement learning, or multimodal generation and understanding.
2.Deep understanding of the internal mechanisms of both video generation and VLM models; familiar with diffusion model principles.
3.Research experience in interactive video generation or controllable video generation.

title: Research Intern – Video World Models (Research & ML Systems) 107752
description:
Business Unit

What the Role Entails
About the Position 
We are seeking an exceptional Research Intern to join our core team in building the next generation of interactive Video World Models. While traditional generative AI focuses on generating passive pixels (e.g., text-to-video), our mission is fundamentally more ambitious: we are building foundational "World Models" that inherently understand physics, causality, action spaces, and complex dynamics directly from internet-scale data. Our goal is to train models that can simulate and "dream" complex virtual worlds, allowing users and agents to explore and interact with them in real time.
This is not a purely theoretical role. 
Training interactive world models at this scale requires pushing the limits of modern computing power. We operate at the intersection of cutting-edge generative AI research and high-performance machine learning systems. We are looking for "full-stack" hacker-researchers—visionary thinkers who are also elite engineers, capable of co-designing novel neural architectures and engineering the highly optimized infrastructure required to train them across large-scale computing cluster.What You Will Do
Architect & Scale Foundation Models: Design, train, and scale state-of-the-art interactive world models (combining Diffusion, Autoregressive Transformers, VAEs, LLMs, VLMs) on massive video datasets.
Push the Boundaries of ML Systems: Architect highly scalable distributed training pipelines, utilizing advanced model and data parallelism to train massive models efficiently on large-scale computing cluters.
Optimize for Efficiency: Profile and optimize model architectures to break through memory and compute bottlenecks. Write high-performance, custom hardware kernels to maximize Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) and enable real-time, low-latency inference.

Who We Look For
Requirements
Academic Excellence: Currently pursuing a PhD (or Master’s degree with a truly exceptional research/engineering track record) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Architecture, or a related field.
Engineering Skills: Exceptional, production-level coding proficiency in Python or other languages. Background in competitive programming is a great plus.
AI Infrastructure & Scaling: Experience with modern AI infrastructure stack and large-scale machine learning systems, such as PyTorch FSDP, Megatron, etc. Experience with GPU kernels using CUDA and/or Triton is a great plus.
Deep Generative Expertise: Thorough theoretical and practical understanding of modern generative paradigms (Diffusion, Vision Transformers, Autoregressive sequence modeling, discrete tokenization/VAEs).
Top-Tier Publication Record: First-author publications in top-tier AI venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV) OR premier ML Systems venues (MLSys, OSDI, ASPLOS).
Location State(s)
US-California-Palo Alto

title: Financial Risk Control Manager
description:
Business Unit
Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Corporate Development Group (CDG): as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.
Position Overview
Responsible for building the full-chain risk management framework for the company's overseas businesses, covering end-to-end business lifecycle management and dynamic risk control. The role requires deep understanding of international AML regulatory frameworks (FATF Recommendations, Singapore MAS, Hong Kong HKMA, EU AMLD, US BSA/AML, etc.), leading the design and implementation of core risk control functions including due diligence, risk rating, and suspicious transaction monitoring, ensuring the company's overseas operations maintain continuous compliance across all jurisdictions while scaling rapidly.Risk Control Framework: Enhance the AML risk control framework covering pre-event, in-event, and post-event stages; drive the implementation of systematic and automated risk control capabilities to ensure end-to-end risk management.
Full Business Lifecycle Risk Management: Lead risk assessments for overseas business especially acquiring throughout their lifecycle; conduct ML/TF risk assessments before new business/product launches and implement control measures; maintain dynamic risk monitoring and strategy iteration during ongoing operations, with enhanced strategy deployment for high-risk businesses.
Customer Due Diligence (KYB/CDD/EDD): Optimize overseas KYB onboarding standards and review processes; enhance CDD and EDD frameworks; conduct in-depth background and transaction analysis on high-risk customers; drive the digitalization and automation of due diligence workflows.
Risk Rating: Maintain and refine multi-dimensional customer/merchant risk rating models; optimize dynamic adjustment and periodic re-assessment mechanisms; deploy tiered risk control strategies and measures based on rating outcomes.
Suspicious Transaction Monitoring & Risk Control: Design real-time monitoring rules and interception strategies, as well as post-event analysis models; lead suspicious transaction analysis and the preparation of STR/SAR reports; conduct regular back-testing and optimization of monitoring rules and models.

Who We Look For
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or above in law, finance, risk management, accounting, or a related field.
Proficiency in English and Mandarin are required, due to business operation needs to liaise with headquarters, regulators, and business counterparts.
3+ years of experience in AML, financial crime compliance, or risk management; experience in payment institutions, banks, or fintech companies preferred.
Strong knowledge of the FATF 40 Recommendations and methodology; in-depth understanding of requirements under Singapore MAS, Hong Kong HKMA/MSO, EU AMLD, US BSA/AML frameworks, and other major jurisdictions.
Strong logical reasoning and data sensitivity; ability to identify anomalous patterns and risk signals from data.
Resilience under pressure; able to effectively drive work forward in a multi-tasking, fast-paced regulatory environment.
Excellent cross-functional communication and coordination skills; able to align business, product, technology, and operations teams to implement risk control requirements.
​Preferred Qualifications
Background in data analytics and AI applications; experience with AML/risk control systems driven by machine learning or rule engines.
Experience in merchants acquiring，cross-border payments, cryptocurrency, or Web3 anti-fraud/AML compliance.

title: World Model Research Intern 107779
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
Focus on cutting-edge algorithm research and development for World Models and Video Diffusion Models, exploring key issues such as video generation and video interaction. As a Generative AI Researcher (Intern), you will participate in one or more of the following tasks:
Data Processing: Assist with the cleaning, filtering, annotation, and preprocessing pipelines for large-scale video/image data to build high-quality training datasets.
Model Training: Help build highly efficient training frameworks for diffusion models, optimize training workflows, and take responsibility for managing, monitoring, and fine-tuning model training tasks.
Technical Innovation: Deeply participate in technical project discussions, proactively propose innovative ideas or improvement plans, and actively drive the practical application and integration of research findings into game video generation and virtual world construction scenarios.
Frontier Exploration: Collaborate closely with senior researchers to explore cutting-edge directions in the fields of digital content generation and interactive agents.

Who We Look For
Enrolled as a PhD or Master’s student in Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, Machine Learning, or a related field, familiarity with generative models.
Strong background in deep learning with practical experience in image or video data processing. Capable of independently handling complex data cleaning tasks and constructing robust data pipelines.
Strong interest in applying generative AI to interactive entertainment and virtual world building.

岗位职责

We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. As a Strategic Investment Manager, you will:

4. More importantly, drive development of new opportunities and incubate new businesses.

8. Plan and manage business incubation, drive product innovation and new partnerships, develop and execute go-to-market plan.
9. Make key investment decisions.
10. Monitor domestic and global game market. Identify emerging industry/technology trends.

岗位要求
1. Around 2+ years of experience in the gaming industry — backgrounds in game studios/publishers, strategy consulting, investment banking, or PE/VC are all welcome.
2. Strategic vision and business insight, with deep knowledge of the gaming, media, and entertainment industry — particularly well-versed in gaming UGC and the landscape of major game studios and publishers.
3. Ability in interpretation of data and identify emerging market trends and business opportunities.
4. Must be a self-starter, comfortable with uncertainty, and ability to drive to answers through disciplined work, while also collaborating with cross-functional teams.
5. Are effective team players with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
6. Exceptional proficiency with MS Excel & PowerPoint; working knowledge of statistics and analysis packages.
8. Have an entrepreneurial spirit.

title: Tencent Cloud- Senior Strategic Sales Executive (Gen AI & Cloud) – Singapore
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Identify, prospect, and develop strategic enterprise opportunities for Tencent Cloud’s AI and cloud solutions within the Singapore and SouthEast Asian market.
Build and manage executive-level relationships with customers, AI native companies, digital-native companies, ISVs, and enterprise organizations adopting Generative AI technologies.

Develop strategic account plans, pipeline forecasts, territory plans, and executive business reviews to consistently exceed revenue targets.

Analyze industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging AI use cases to identify new business opportunities and develop go-to-market strategies.
Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams to maximize customer success, expansion opportunities, and long-term account growth.

title: Legal Counsel (Overseas Advertising Platform & Public Welfare Projects Compliance)
description:
Business Unit
The S1 Legal & Administration Line functions as the backbone support system for corporate security, legal affairs, government affairs, administrative affairs, procurement, infrastructure, and corporate social responsibility.

What the Role Entails
Tencent is launching its 2026 Greater Bay Area (GBA) Program and seeking a Legal Counsel to support its overseas advertising platforms and public welfare initiatives. As an important member of Tencent's overseas legal team, you will have an exciting opportunity to support international business, products, and platforms across advertising, open-source software, and AI in multiple jurisdictions.
2026 GBA Program Eligibility
Greater Bay Area Youth Employment Scheme: https://www1.jobs.gov.hk/0/en/information/gbayes/
Hong Kong Permanent Resident holder
Early-career candidates encouraged to apply (recent graduates and those at the start of their professional path are welcome).
Willing to complete a 12-month on-site training placement in Shenzhen during the initial stage of employment.
Bachelor's degree or above.
Key Responsibilities
Advise on the legal and compliance aspects of overseas products and platform operations, including product features, platform governance, user onboarding, user-facing disclosures, AI-related features, and cross-border launches
Build and improve the compliance framework for the overseas business, including policies, standard operating procedures, risk assessments, approval workflows, training, and knowledge management.
Track and analyze legal and regulatory developments in key overseas markets, including AI, platform governance, data protection, advertising, and consumer protection, and support compliance assessments for product features, business initiatives, and overseas launches.
Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including technology service agreements, procurement agreements, as well as other commercial contracts.
Conduct legal assessments and market entry research covering advertising and marketing regulation, consumer protection, privacy and data protection, content moderation, and sector-specific requirements.
Provide strategic, end-to-end legal and compliance support for the global expansion and implementation of overseas public welfare initiatives, including contract review, legal risk assessment, governance support and other legal work across the project lifecycle.
Collaborate with external counsel and other Tencent attorneys based around the world, including in Singapore, the EU, the US and other relevant jurisdictions, to provide practical compliance and regulatory analysis for international business initiatives.
Identify legal and regulatory risks early, and develop practical, scalable solutions for business, product, and platform teams.

Who We Look For
Key expectations and criteria:
Education: Exceptional academic credentials, including an advanced law degree from a prestigious, internationally recognized law school. Admission to practice in a major overseas jurisdiction is strongly preferred.
Experience: Minimum 1-3 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) gained at leading law firms or multinational corporations. Experience in advertising, media, platform businesses, or regulatory compliance is a strong plus
Compliance Systems Experience: Hands-on experience in building or enhancing compliance frameworks, including policies, template documentation, approval workflows, training programs, and knowledge management tools, with the ability to drive operational efficiency in line with both international standards and local regulatory requirements.
Business Judgment: Sound business acumen with the ability to deliver practical, commercially pragmatic, and comprehensive legal advice in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to build trusted, effective relationships with business stakeholders across different functions and levels.
Independence & Project Management: Ability to work independently, effectively prioritize competing demands, and manage end-to-end project processes—from initial legal assessment and contract negotiation through to implementation and post-launch risk management.
Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable operating under pressure in a fast-paced, constantly evolving technology environment, with the ability to handle complex, time-sensitive, and multi-jurisdictional matters.
Learning Agility: Quick learner with a genuine interest in the latest developments in overseas regulation, platform compliance, and emerging technologies.
Language: Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English (written and spoken) as working languages.

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner.
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more. The WeChat Pay team in Japan is responsible for its increasing in all aspects of Japanese markets.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
- 业务运营（Business Operations）：与 Business Development（BD）团队协作，加强客户关系并探索业务机会。
- 与 Key Account（KA）商户或机构就接入、物料及活动等事项进行协作推进。

A. 门店巡检（Store Inspection）：实地走访线下门店，确认物料铺设情况。
B. 市场动态（Market Dynamics）：通过线上调研、行业报告及实地走访，定期收集关键市场信息，对支付生态健康度进行评估与对比。
C. 用户调研（User Research）：通过线下走访或线上问卷，统计用户渗透率及用户体验情况。
- 物料铺设（Material Deployment）：针对机构较难覆盖的区域或场景，安排线下物料部署。
- 合作拓展（Collaboration Exploration）：与大学社团、核心商圈等建立合作，推进用户社区营销渗透，实地观察消费场景，开展调研与数据分析，并探索微信生态内的合作机会。
- ビジネスオペレーション（Business Operations）：Business Development（BD）チームと連携し、顧客関係の強化およびビジネス機会の開拓を推進。
- Key Account（KA）加盟店・機関と連携し、導入、販促物、キャンペーン施策等の推進を行う。
- 市場調査（Market Research）：以下を含むが、これらに限定されない。
A. 店舗巡回（Store Inspection）：オフライン店舗を訪問し、販促物の設置状況を確認。
B. 市場動向調査（Market Dynamics）：オンライン調査、業界レポート、現地訪問を通じて重要な市場情報を定期的に収集し、決済エコシステムの健全性を評価・比較。
C. ユーザー調査（User Research）：現地訪問やオンラインアンケートを通じて、ユーザー浸透率およびユーザー体験に関するデータを収集。
- 販促物展開（Material Deployment）：機関側ではカバーが難しいエリアやシーンに対して、現地での販促物設置を実施。
- 協業開拓（Collaboration Exploration）：大学サークルや主要商業エリア等との連携を推進し、ユーザーコミュニティ向けマーケティング浸透を実施。現地で消費行動を観察し、調査・データ分析を行いながら、WeChatエコシステム内での協業機会を探索。

title: Global Talent Sourcing Intern 107832
description:
Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails
About Tencent
Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.
As part of our strategic expansion, we are excited to announce the development of our own in-house sourcing hub, designed to streamline our recruitment processes and enhance our talent acquisition capabilities. In line with this initiative, we are seeking motivated interns who have a keen interest in the field of recruiting and are eager to deepen their understanding of the intricacies involved in talent identification and acquisition.
Roles & Responsiblities
Collaborating with the hiring team to understand their specific requirements and qualifications required to source for open positions
Conducting market research to understand where potential candidates may be found, best methods to engage with them and market/industry trends
Building Talent Pools for evergreen positions, keeping and maintaining candidate pipelines across various platforms and groups
Outreach and engagement with potential candidates through emails, social media, or phone calls to gauge their interest in open positions and to inform them about job opportunities
Generation of referrals by encouraging both candidates and employees to refer qualified candidates
Report and analyse existing projects in terms of sourcing strategies’ effectiveness, such as conversion rates and how to improve the sourcing process

Who We Look For
Qualifications
Currently an undergraduate or master’s degree student in Human Resources or its equivalent
Ideally with prior recruitment and/or sourcing experience with exposure to Boolean searches
Strong analytical skills, proficiency in gathering and analysing information, and ability to identify problems through the information.
Ability to adapt to cross-regional and cross-cultural work patterns. Great teamwork spirit, strong communication skills, and fast-learning ability.
Ability to communicate bilingually (English / Mandarin) to deal with stakeholders from HQ and international teams

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: パブリッシングプロデューサー（スタジオ パブリッシング）｜Publishing Producer（Studio Publishing）
description:
チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite は、テンセントのグローバルゲームブランドとして、世界中のゲーム、開発チーム、スタジオにワンストップなサービスネットワークを提供するグローバルなゲームパブリッシャーです。私たちは、いつでもどこでも、誰もが楽しめる魅力的で独創的なゲーム体験を提供すると同時に、包容力があり、すべてのプレイヤーを繋ぐコミュニティの育成に尽力しています。また、Level Infiniteは、世界中の開発者やパートナースタジオに対し、幅広いサービスとリソースを提供することで、ゲームに秘められたポテンシャルを最大限に引き出すサポートも行っています。
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world. We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
パブリッシング プロデューサーは、担当スタジオと連携し、高品質なグローバルパブリッシング戦略を推進することが役割です。本ポジションは、データ分析を踏まえたGTM（Go-To-Market）戦略、インサイト、オペレーション構築・リソース管理、クロスファンクショナル連携、そしてキャンペーン運営の卓越性を組み合わせたものです。
この役割では、スタジオのリーダーシップと直接連携し、パブリッシングロードマップの策定、Tencent のグローバル基準との整合性の確保、パブリッシングの優先順位の設定、そしてマーケティング、コンテンツ、商業戦略、リサーチ、プラットフォームなど広範な領域で遂行の支援を行います。
理想的な候補者は、戦略的思考、分析力、構造的なアプローチ、高い協働力を兼ね備え、複数市場でのゲームパブリッシング、複雑なクロスリージョン環境、そしてパブリッシングプロセスの実務経験を有する方です。スタジオパートナーシップ
明確で具体的な価値を継続的に提供することで、スタジオとの強い信頼関係を構築する。
スタジオリーダーの戦略的パートナーとして実務的な助言を行い、透明性のあるコミュニケーションを提供し、Tencent のリソースにつなぐ役割を担う。
パブリッシング戦略
スタジオと共にグローバルパブリッシング戦略とワークフローを共同リードする。
パブリッシングの準備状況、GTM 方向性、マーケティングアプローチを体系的に評価する。
Tencent のグローバル機能をスタジオのパイプラインに統合する。
長期的なパブリッシング計画を明確な責任範囲と意思決定プロセスとともに整合させる。
GTM & キャンペーンリード
ポジショニング、セグメンテーション、コンテンツロードマップ、KPI、キャンペーン構造などGTM 立案をリードする。
インサイトチームと連携し、リサーチ、競合分析、プレイテスト、データに基づく提案を GTM の基盤として取り入れる。
クリエイティブアセットや拡散戦略のレビューと検証を行う。
スタジオのパブリッシング計画を広げるためのビジネス機会やパートナーシップを特定する。
キャンペーンの KPI を追跡し、ライフサイクル全体を通じて最適化案を提示する。
オペレーション & クロスファンクショナル調整
スタジオ内および Tencent リソース間のマーケティング、コンテンツ、コミュニティ、PR、商業、プラットフォームなどのチームとの整合を推進する。
効率的なパブリッシングワークフローとレポーティング体制をスタジオと共に確立する。
ROI とマイルストーンに基づいた予算運用の効率性を評価する。
Tencent チームとスタジオリーダーシップの間で、パブリッシング関連の明確なコミュニケーションを促進する。
市場 & パフォーマンス評価
グローバルパブリッシングに関連する市場動向、プラットフォームの変化、競合の動きを監視し、スタジオを知見で支援する。
プロダクト品質、ゲームプレイの完成度、ユーザーの反応を評価し、改善提案につなげる。
リーダーシップ & メンタリング
スタジオ、外部パートナー、Tencent チームと強く協働的な関係を構築する。
パブリッシング担当者を指導し、スタジオおよび Tencent のパブリッシング水準の向上に貢献する。

応募資格/Who We Look For
経験・専門性： 
ゲームパブリッシング、GTM、またはスタジオ支援業務における 12 年以上の経験。 パブリッシング戦略、インサイト、クリエイティブ／コンテンツ、商業、プラットフォームなどグローバルパブリッシングフレームワークの深い理解。
スキル・能力：
 高い分析力、優れたクロスファンクショナル調整能力、明快なコミュニケーション力、権限がなくても影響力を発揮できる力、KPI やリサーチの解釈能力。

 協働的で柔軟、プロアクティブかつ戦略と実務のバランスを持った方。

title: Lead Game Development Expert, AI-Asset & Animation Production
description:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a lead game development expert with deep AAA production experience to strengthen co-development and technical partnership between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios.
The successful candidate will bring a strong technical art and animation background, with a particular focus on asset production and animation workflows. Instead of covering the full breadth of art disciplines, this role concentrates on AI-enabled asset creation, asset performance optimisation, asset visual fidelity and on the animation side skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.Participate in co-development projects between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios, providing senior expertise in AI-enabled asset production, asset performance optimisation, asset visual quality, skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.
Make AI-driven asset and animation improvement a central pillar of technical collaboration. Identify concrete opportunities across the full asset lifecycle (modelling, texturing, materials, LODs, performance profiling) and animation disciplines (skeleton generation, skinning, control rigs, cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics and ragdoll setups).
Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept projects that integrate AI tools with existing asset authoring tools, animation rigging environments, physics engines, and Unreal Engine or equivalent game engines.
Evaluate the suitability, feasibility and expected value of AI solutions for asset and animation challenges. Define measurable metrics covering asset creation time, memory/performance budgets, visual fidelity, rigging speed, animation quality, physics stability and overall pipeline scalability.
Work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Animators, Riggers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, Engineers, Producers and AI specialists to translate creative and production requirements into practical, measurable solutions focused on assets and animation.
Drive the transition of successful AI experiments into daily production workflows. Collect user feedback, refine asset and animation pipelines, and document repeatable implementation approaches for asset generation, optimisation, rigging automation and physics setup.
Establish human-review and quality-control mechanisms for AI-assisted asset and animation workflows, ensuring visual consistency, animation fidelity, physical plausibility, performance targets and intellectual property/data security are respected.
Lead technical investigations and solution designs for complex asset production challenges (e.g., automated LOD generation, material and texture optimisation, shader performance) and animation challenges (e.g., auto-rigging, physics-aware motion, real-time cloth simulation).
Bridge overseas studio requirements with Tencent’s internal AI capabilities, asset platforms, animation technology stacks and subject-matter experts.
Document reusable AI use cases, asset pipeline standards, rigging and physics best practices, performance guidelines and evaluation methods. Share knowledge through workshops, technical reviews and project retrospectives.
Monitor trends in generative AI, neural rendering, procedural content generation, machine learning for deformation and physics, digital humans and real-time graphics, assessing their practical value for AAA asset and animation production.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Graphics, Digital Media, Game Development, Art and Design, Animation, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
At least 8 years of professional experience in technical art, animation technology or a closely related discipline, with significant exposure to AAA asset and animation pipelines.
Experience operating as a Senior Technical Artist, Lead Technical Artist, Technical Art Director, Animation Pipeline Lead, Rigging Lead or equivalent senior role with a clear focus on assets and/or animation.
Proven development experience on a recognised AAA game project, including at least one shipped AAA title where you were directly responsible for asset optimisation, rigging, or physics-animation workflows.
Strong understanding of the complete AAA asset and animation lifecycle, from initial modelling and rigging, through version control and validation, to engine integration, performance profiling and runtime optimisation.
Strong interest in generative AI, machine learning and intelligent automation, especially as applied to asset generation, asset optimisation, auto-rigging, motion synthesis, deformation prediction and physics simulation.
Ability to identify high-value AI opportunities rooted in real asset and animation production challenges and progress them through proof-of-concept, workflow design, tool integration and production adoption.
Strong experience with Unreal Engine or another major game engine, including real-time rendering, asset management, animation blueprints, physics assets and cross-platform performance constraints.
Proficiency in Blender or Maya; working knowledge of Houdini is a plus.
Experience with tools development or workflow automation using Python, C++, Blueprint or equivalent, particularly for asset processing, rigging automation or physics pipeline tools.
Strong problem-solving, solution design and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance asset quality, animation expressiveness, engineering feasibility and production efficiency.
Excellent English communication skills, able to lead technical discussions, conduct solution reviews, prepare documentation and collaborate effectively in an international environment.
Willingness to work across regions and time zones and to travel to partner studios in Europe or other locations when required.

Deep expertise in several of the following areas:
​​(1) AAA asset production pipelines (characters, environments, props) with a strong emphasis on performance optimisation, memory budgets, LOD strategies and visual consistency.
(2) Asset visual quality and efficiency: material authoring, texture optimisation, shading models, draw call management and cross-platform asset validation.
(3) Skeleton design and character/creature rigging: hierarchical structures, joint placement, modular rig systems, and auto-rigging methods.
(4) Skinning and deformation: linear blend skinning, dual quaternion skinning, corrective blendshapes, muscle systems and deformation quality control.
(5) Physics-based animation: cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics, ragdoll setups, secondary motion, and real-time physics constraints in engine.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

Deep understanding of finance and planning domains, including core financial management, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, projects, expenses, and supplier management
Strong experience translating business and functional requirements into sustainable, scalable system solutions
Proven expertise across the full application development lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, and support
Experience delivering large-scale ERP or enterprise cloud transformation initiatives
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively across geographies, time zones, and cross-functional teams
Experience integrating ERP or finance platforms with third-party systems
Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to change and manage competing priorities
Strong technical project leadership and stakeholder management skills
